title: Senior Software Engineer - Integrations 3P - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Integrations Team and help us build how Elastic shows up inside the AI ecosystem. AI assistants and agentic tools are quickly becoming the place where developers start their work, and this role exists to make Elastic work in the tools and ecosystems that our users use. We want to be easy to find, easy to connect to, and easy to use.

The Integrations team owns the developer-facing surfaces that connect Elastic to the broader ecosystem: language clients, CLI, MCP server, third-party integrations, and the skills that make Elastic accessible wherever developers work. You'll build and maintain these projects, engage directly with the developer community, and contribute across team and cross-functional initiatives.

This is fast-moving territory. We want someone who enjoys an ambiguous, quick-shifting space, who forms opinions about what should be built and not only how, and who is comfortable working closely with our product teams and external partners.

Prior experience with the Elastic product suite is not essential, but is beneficial.

What You Will Be Doing

  • You'll build and evolve the Elastic MCP server and the infrastructure behind it, working primarily in Go.
  • You'll build the platform for universal agent skills: the portable format, the authoring and publishing tooling, and the linting that lets any team at Elastic ship a skill that runs across every agent.
  • You'll help set the correctness bar, making sure the skills and tools we ship are backed by evals rather than assumed to work.
  • You'll design and deliver integrations that make Elastic available inside third-party AI ecosystems. For that you’ll work closely with our product team and third-party partners to shape and land those integrations.
  • You'll contribute to our Elastic CLI to enhance the efficiency of developers and their agents.
  • You'll be developing, maintaining, and supporting libraries, tools, and integrations related to the Elastic Stack, working in a mixture of languages including Go and Rust.
  • You'll bring product thinking to the team, holding and defending opinions on what we should build and why, informed by the ecosystem around us.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience working on backend systems, services or libraries.
  • Proficiency with AI/ML frameworks and a working understanding of LLMs, agents, agent skills and protocols such as MCP. Interest in proving correctness through evaluation rather than assuming it.
  • Significant recent working experience of Go and (ideally) other languages.
  • Knowledge of client-server networking, HTTP, and RESTful APIs.
  • Comfort reading and contributing to codebases in languages you don't own, and no fear of picking up an unfamiliar one.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices in software engineering.
  • Product thinking: an interest in the wider ecosystem and strong opinions on what is worth building.
  • A strong focus on usability and developer experience.
  • Comfort with context-switching and with a space that changes quickly.
  • A genuine interest in technology and an active interest in exploring multiple programming languages.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, including in front of customers and external partners.
  • A willingness to work as part of a remote, globally distributed team.
  • Clear thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to learn and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or operating infrastructure, and an interest in telemetry and observability (nice to have)
  • A connection to technical communities through open source projects, blogs or talks (nice to have)
  • Experience working with third-party or partner engineering teams (nice to have)
  • Prior experience of Elastic products (nice to have)

descriptionHtml:

What Is The Role :

The Platform Engineering Productivity team operates the CI, CD, and Release infrastructure for the company. We ensure developers can efficiently and safely deploy changes across our various environments and at scale. In an age of AI, the landscape is evolving rapidly from scaling needs to, more than ever, securing our supply chain. There are interesting challenges to tackle.   We're looking for a proactive systems thinker who delivers on business-driven projects while identifying and driving the work that keeps our infrastructure ahead before scaling and security challenges become problems. If you're energized by work that makes every engineering team at Elastic ship faster and more securely, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Define the roadmap and technical vision for CI/CD, from problem identification through org-wide adoption.
  • Identify where CI/CD is a bottleneck, a source of friction, or a security risk before it becomes an incident, and drive the remediation rather than waiting to be assigned it.
  • Design and enforce release gates covering supply chain integrity, artifact provenance, and release readiness, built to scale across teams without becoming a tax on engineering velocity.
  • Direct engineers on your team through complex, multi-quarter projects: break down the architecture, assign the work, and own the outcome even when the execution is distributed.
  • Drive clear technical communication and alignment across teams, and produce high-quality documentation for systems, processes, and architectural decisions.
  • Serve as Incident Commander on high-severity supply chain or release incidents, and use each incident as a forcing function for structural improvements.
  • Raise the engineering bar across the org through code review, mentorship, design review, and by setting standards others adopt voluntarily.
  • Remain hands-on at the right depth: you'll review code, prototype approaches, and debug production issues, but your primary leverage at this level is through the work of others, not your own output.

What You Bring :

  • Deep expertise in CI/CD and what it takes to harden a release pipeline against supply chain attacks.
  • Strong debugging instincts across the full pipeline stack: you trace failures from test runner to artifact store to cluster deployment without needing a specialist for each layer.
  • Hands-on with CI infrastructure (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), GitOps/ArgoCD, and Kubernetes.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own work and your team's and you understand AI's impact on supply chain security and scale.
  • A track record of multi-quarter, cross-org ownership: you've identified the right problem, designed the solution, and gotten organizations that didn't report to you to change how they work.
  • The judgment to push back on a prescribed plan when it's the wrong call, and the credibility to get alignment on a better approach.
  • Experience directing the work of other engineers toward outcomes not just collaborating, but breaking down complex problems into executable work and holding the outcome.

This is a hands-on build role that will develop and maintain HR's data pipelines on our GCP/BigQuery/dbt data model, with an AI-powered analytics layer on top. Core platform infrastructure is provisioned centrally; you'll help configure HR-specific pipelines and dbt modeling work on top of it, in partnership with our data scientist, and stand up recruiting reporting and insights as the first production use case on the new stack. This role reports directly to the Director of HR Analytics, with high visibility into architecture and stakeholder-facing decisions from day one.

Your mission is to move the organization away from manual reporting and toward a mature, self-service environment where senior stakeholders get decision-ready answers, not just data.

What You Will Be Doing

Build and Deploy Scalable Analytics

  • Build and maintain data pipelines in BigQuery/dbt, on infrastructure provisioned by the central data platform team, that link HR data across the employee lifecycle (Workday, Greenhouse, Qualtrics, ServiceNow), so we can trace how hiring decisions affect long-term engagement and retention.
  • Support and enhance the AI-powered analytics user experience.
  • Develop scalable, self-service dashboards that reduce time spent on reactive, one-off data requests.
  • Implement data governance practices (access controls, validation, documentation) in line with team standards for sensitive HR and compensation data.
  • Build data proficiency across the broader HR team as part of the shift to self-service.

Recruiting Reporting and Insight Engine

  • Automate recurring recruiting reports to eliminate manual data wrangling.
  • Translate talent data into insights that identify pipeline bottlenecks, improve candidate experience, and improve hiring efficiency.
  • Monitor recruiting data for anomalies and build validation checks to establish one version of the truth across systems.

Technical Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Strong SQL and Python skills.
  • Direct experience extracting and modeling data from at least one major HRIS or ATS platform (e.g., Workday, Greenhouse) via its reporting or API layer. General dashboard-level reporting experience is not a substitute.
  • Demonstrated ability to build custom dashboards and data visualizations using standard BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau) or code-based environments (e.g., Python, Streamlit, Plotly).

What You Bring

  • Broad understanding of HR programs and metrics across the employee lifecycle, including recruiting.
  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills for both VP/executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working across geographies and time zones, tailoring insights to diverse audiences.
  • A point of view on AI/LLM-based analytics tools and how they simplify insight delivery – direct experience implementing one is a plus.

title: Principal Software Engineer I - CI/CD - Platform Engineering Productivity
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

The Platform Engineering Productivity team operates the CI, CD, and Release infrastructure for the company. We ensure developers can efficiently and safely deploy changes across our various environments and at scale. In an age of AI, the landscape is evolving rapidly from scaling needs to, more than ever, securing our supply chain. There are interesting challenges to tackle.   We're looking for a proactive systems thinker who delivers on business-driven projects while identifying and driving the work that keeps our infrastructure ahead before scaling and security challenges become problems. If you're energized by work that makes every engineering team at Elastic ship faster and more securely, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Define the roadmap and technical vision for CI/CD, from problem identification through org-wide adoption.
  • Identify where CI/CD is a bottleneck, a source of friction, or a security risk before it becomes an incident, and drive the remediation rather than waiting to be assigned it.
  • Design and enforce release gates covering supply chain integrity, artifact provenance, and release readiness, built to scale across teams without becoming a tax on engineering velocity.
  • Direct engineers on your team through complex, multi-quarter projects: break down the architecture, assign the work, and own the outcome even when the execution is distributed.
  • Drive clear technical communication and alignment across teams, and produce high-quality documentation for systems, processes, and architectural decisions.
  • Serve as Incident Commander on high-severity supply chain or release incidents, and use each incident as a forcing function for structural improvements.
  • Raise the engineering bar across the org through code review, mentorship, design review, and by setting standards others adopt voluntarily.
  • Remain hands-on at the right depth: you'll review code, prototype approaches, and debug production issues, but your primary leverage at this level is through the work of others, not your own output.

What You Bring :

  • Deep expertise in CI/CD and what it takes to harden a release pipeline against supply chain attacks.
  • Strong debugging instincts across the full pipeline stack: you trace failures from test runner to artifact store to cluster deployment without needing a specialist for each layer.
  • Hands-on with CI infrastructure (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), GitOps/ArgoCD, and Kubernetes.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own work and your team's and you understand AI's impact on supply chain security and scale.
  • A track record of multi-quarter, cross-org ownership: you've identified the right problem, designed the solution, and gotten organizations that didn't report to you to change how they work.
  • The judgment to push back on a prescribed plan when it's the wrong call, and the credibility to get alignment on a better approach.
  • Experience directing the work of other engineers toward outcomes not just collaborating, but breaking down complex problems into executable work and holding the outcome.

What is The Role

As Distributor Business Development Manager, you will own Elastic's distribution relationships and unmanaged Elastic partner strategy with distribution partners across APJ region.   The successful candidate will connect Elastic's sales teams, partner teams, and distributors in the region. Their main goal is to drive pipeline generation with the help of distributors. They will also enable resellers and execute co-sell strategies. Additionally, they will work on growing new business and increasing expansion ARR through the partner ecosystem.   This role requires a candidate with strong partner sales acumen, regional experience and proven track record of growing business with distributors. You will work with cross-functional teams, and focus on driving execution of Elastic sales plays, deep technical alignment and enablement of distributors and will scale business through distributor led partner ecosystem.   As a business leader, you will conduct executive business reviews with both the distributor and Elastic leadership teams. You should be capable and comfortable delivering demonstrations of Elastic products. You will arrange technical workshops and certification boot camps with distributors and Elastic reseller teams. Additionally, you will create and improve sales plays. And most importantly drive business execution across distributors and distributor-led partner ecosystem.

What You Will Be Doing

Distribution Strategy & Business Planning:
  • Manage business plans with distribution partners. Set quarterly targets for the pipeline and for recruiting resellers. Prioritize segments for Elastic's Enterprise, Public Sector, and Commercial business.
  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with distribution executive team, and drive business growth initiatives with Elastic Field Sales teams, Managed Partners teams, and distributors
  • Develop and execute a distribution GTM playbook aligned to Elastic's Fiscal year priorities and key performance indicators such as: partner-sourced pipeline, New & Expansion business targets and reseller coverage model.
  • Work with Global Partner Sales Operations to track distributor performance using KPIs. These KPIs include partner-sourced ARR, deal registration volume, pipeline coverage ratio, and reseller activation rates.
Distributor and Partner Ecosystem Enablement and Development:

descriptionHtml:

By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role   We're looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering & Architecture team. In this role, you'll help grow a Data Platform that makes it easier for teams across our company to work with data confidently and effectively. Your work will directly support our business goals not just by keeping data flowing, but by turning it into something people can actually use and trust.   This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys both the technical craft of data engineering and the human side of it: collaborating with partners, sharing knowledge, and helping others get more out of the tools and systems you build together.   What You Will Be Doing   You'll design, maintain, and improve the pipelines and infrastructure that power our data platform. Day to day, that means working across the full data lifecycle — from ingestion and streaming to transformation and delivery — using tools like Apache Airflow, Spark, Iceberg, Kafka, Flink, and dbt Labs.   Beyond the technical work, you'll spend meaningful time with stakeholders to understand what they need and help define how data should flow across systems. That includes co-creating data contracts, writing clear documentation, and guiding teammates on how to get the most out of the platform.   A few other things you'll take on:
  • Monitor and refine pipeline performance and refine processes to keep things running smoothly.
  • Use Terraform to provision and manage resources on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Help steward the platform by reviewing code and ensuring good practices and standard processes are followed.
  • Process access requests and support compliance with platform policies.
What You Bring
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles
  • Experience with Apache Airflow for orchestrating data workflows
  • Experience with Spark, Flink, Kafka, and dbt Labs for data processing and transformation
  • Understanding of Apache Iceberg for data table formats and data warehouse and lakehouse strategies
  • Skilled in using Terraform for infrastructure-as-code deployments
  • Proficient in programming languages, particularly Bash, Python, and SQL
  • Knowledge of database systems, including OLAP, OLTP, Document, and Vector databases

Center of Excellence & Governance

  • Build and maintain the ABM knowledge hub - ensuring plays, findings, and procedures are detailed and accessible

Leadership & Coaching

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. What is The Role

The Observability Streams team at Elastic is building Elastic's unified data pipeline - the layer that connects where your data comes from to where it lands, with full control over how it's processed and routed along the way. Whether you're collecting metrics from cloud accounts, shipping logs from agents, or routing traces to different destinations, Streams is what ties it all together.   The Streams Backend team is responsible for the backend services powering this pipeline, ensuring data is routed, processed, and delivered efficiently and reliably at scale. We also own Logstash, the open-source streaming ETL tool (and the “L” in the “ELK stack”) trusted by enterprises worldwide to move and transform data, and we are regular contributors to the OpenTelemetry Collector.   As a Senior software engineer on the Streams Backend team,you will help drive the design and development of new features across the Streams Backend service and Logstash, contribute to the OpenTelemetry Collector, and support our users and enterprise customers.   Our team is distributed across the globe, and we communicate mostly through Slack, GitHub, email and Zoom.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Designing and implementing new features for Logstash and its plugins in Java and JRuby.
  • Designing, building, and operating core backend services for the Streams program in Golang.
  • Adding new features, and making contributions to the Open Telemetry Collector in Golang.
  • Solving hard distributed systems problems at scale.
  • Maintaining, updating and improving existing code and dependencies while ensuring automated test coverage.
  • Engaging with multiple public GitHub repositories and community forums.
  • Providing Pull Request reviews and guidance to your peers.
  • Collaborating with other teams to drive product goals.
  • Working together with the support organization to help our customers, which will also include participating in an on-call rotation.

What You Bring

  • Ability to work in a remote-first, highly distributed environment, with top-notch verbal and written communication.
  • Proficient analytical, problem solving, debugging skills and ability to find efficient solutions.
  • Critical thinking, positivity, autonomy and adaptability.
  • Expertise in at least one of Java, Golang and Ruby, and willingness to learn and work with the others and ability to adapt to regularly working in different codebases.
  • Clear written communication and the ability to work proficiently in a remote-first, highly distributed team.
  • A proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with observability tools and concepts (tracing, metrics, logging), especially experience with or interest in OpenTelemetry
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • JRuby development
  • Open source software development
  • Knowledge of stream processing platforms (such as Kafka), database technologies (e.g., Postgres or MySQL) and network technologies (e.g., TCP, UDP and HTTP).
  • Exposure to the Elastic stack.

What Is The Role


Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Public Sector Account Executive to lead our growth into State Government and High Education - a significant market opportunity for
Elastic.This is a critical hire for our business, we need someone with a genuine track record selling into State Government and/or High Education, the instincts of a Challenger seller, and the hustle to build pipeline and create new opportunities in complex, multi stakeholder accounts. Always driving value for the customers we serve. To excel as an Account Executive at Elastic, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isnt just a product, but a versatile search,observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems. As a Public Sector Account Executive, you will be an integral part of our growth strategy. You will drive net-new revenue and expansion within Public Sector Accounts in an assigned territory. This is an opportunity for those passionate about empowering government and education through innovative search technology and analytics, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data.

What You Will Be Doing

● Prospect; Create Opportunities: Proactively build and self generate pipeline in net new government/higher education accounts through outbound prospecting, event and network driven activity       and creative account penetration - this is a build role, not a farm role.
● Drive Adoption: Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within (new) Enterprise accounts while deepening engagement with
   existing ones.
● Be a Trusted Advisor: Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights.
● Sovereignty; Compliance Fluency: Speak credibly to the data sovereignty, security clearance, and compliance requirements that shape how government and Education clients evaluate and             procure technology, and position Elastics platform accordingly.
● Identify New Use Cases: Showcase how Elastic's solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently.
   Solve Complex Problems: Help customers get ahead of exploding data volumes and emerging agentic AI-driven threats by giving them the observability and visibility to see, secure, and act on       what's happening across their environment. 
● Champion Open Source: Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings.
● Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive business plans using community, customer, and partner ecosystems to drive significant territory growth.
● Navigate Sales Cycles: Proactively identify new opportunities and successfully manage complex sales cycles.
● Deep discovery; qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
● Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer
  outcomes.

What You Bring


● The Right Blend: A combination of high-level technical curiosity and the grit of a value-based seller.

title: Principal AI Engineer - Context - Agents and Context
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Context Engine team builds the knowledge layer that AI agents use to work with enterprise data in Elasticsearch. We extract knowledge from any data sources into a structured AI Index, serve it to agents through public APIs, MCP tools and framework integrations, and close the loop with agent traces so that what the engine knows improves from real usage. Any agent can use it: Elastic’s own Agent Builder, Claude Code, LangChain and other third-party harnesses.

As a Principal AI Engineer, you own the improvement loop of this product end to end: how agents, automations and skills behave in production, how we observe them, how we evaluate them, and how we ship changes to them safely. This is a hybrid role at the intersection of engineering, data science, and product. You will write production code, design evaluation and telemetry that product decisions can rest on, and set the technical bar for how the team iterates on agentic behaviour. You will work alongside data scientists, backend engineers, product, and UX, and your work will show up directly in what customers build on top of Elastic.

The codebase is TypeScript and we build it in the open, so you'll be shipping code, designs and discussions in public alongside the rest of the Elastic Stack.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the production improvement loop for Context Engine: understand how extraction automations, retrieval tools and memory behave, based on offline evaluations and customer conversations and telemetry. You help find the failure modes, fix them, and prove the fix.
  • Define how we iterate on agents and skills safely: versioning and rollout of prompts, skills and automations, regression coverage, staged and shadow evaluation, and the guardrails that let us change behaviour without breaking customers.
  • Design the telemetry we need to make data-informed engineering decisions: what to capture from agent traces, tool calls and knowledge retrieval, how it lands in Elasticsearch, and how it feeds evaluation, dashboards and the feedback loop.
  • Partner with the data science team on evaluation strategy: golden datasets, evaluators to gate on quality, latency and cost.
  • Raise the bar across the team: review designs and PRs, mentor engineers in eval-driven development, and write the technical proposals that shape the roadmap.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with the recent years spent shipping and operating AI-driven products on real production traffic, ideally products with public APIs and data models that had to evolve without breaking customers.
  • A track record of eval-driven product improvement: you have diagnosed agent or LLM behaviour from traces and user feedback, designed the evaluation that exposed the problem, shipped the fix and measured the outcome.
  • Direct experience building agents with state and memory, and iterating on prompts, skills and tool behaviour safely in production.
  • You can explain how tool calls and their results flow through each iteration, how context grows across turns and how you manage it, and how the loop decides to stop.
  • Familiarity with MCP, including exposing public MCP servers and tools.
  • Experience designing telemetry for AI systems, and using it to make engineering and product decisions.
  • Experience running product experiments end to end: instrumentation, unattended execution, and interpreting results.
  • Experience building products with public APIs and evolving data models, and the judgement that comes with maintaining external contracts as a product changes.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in either Python or TypeScript: APIs, stateful workflows, data pipelines and production services.
  • Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and product managers as peers, translating between measurement and shipping, and communicating trade-offs clearly.
  • A pragmatic, low-ego style suited to a distributed, async-first team.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, Claude Agent SDK, or similar.
  • Agentic retrieval experience, including knowledge representation.
  • Practical Elasticsearch experience.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Integrations Team and help us build how Elastic shows up inside the AI ecosystem. AI assistants and agentic tools are quickly becoming the place where developers start their work, and this role exists to make Elastic work in the tools and ecosystems that our users use. We want to be easy to find, easy to connect to, and easy to use.

The Integrations team owns the developer-facing surfaces that connect Elastic to the broader ecosystem: language clients, CLI, MCP server, third-party integrations, and the skills that make Elastic accessible wherever developers work. You'll build and maintain these projects, engage directly with the developer community, and contribute across team and cross-functional initiatives.

This is fast-moving territory. We want someone who enjoys an ambiguous, quick-shifting space, who forms opinions about what should be built and not only how, and who is comfortable working closely with our product teams and external partners.

Prior experience with the Elastic product suite is not essential, but is beneficial.

What You Will Be Doing

  • You'll build and evolve the Elastic MCP server and the infrastructure behind it, working primarily in Go.
  • You'll build the platform for universal agent skills: the portable format, the authoring and publishing tooling, and the linting that lets any team at Elastic ship a skill that runs across every agent.
  • You'll help set the correctness bar, making sure the skills and tools we ship are backed by evals rather than assumed to work.
  • You'll design and deliver integrations that make Elastic available inside third-party AI ecosystems. For that you’ll work closely with our product team and third-party partners to shape and land those integrations.
  • You'll contribute to our Elastic CLI to enhance the efficiency of developers and their agents.
  • You'll be developing, maintaining, and supporting libraries, tools, and integrations related to the Elastic Stack, working in a mixture of languages including Go and Rust.
  • You'll bring product thinking to the team, holding and defending opinions on what we should build and why, informed by the ecosystem around us.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience working on backend systems, services or libraries.
  • Proficiency with AI/ML frameworks and a working understanding of LLMs, agents, agent skills and protocols such as MCP. Interest in proving correctness through evaluation rather than assuming it.
  • Significant recent working experience of Go and (ideally) other languages.
  • Knowledge of client-server networking, HTTP, and RESTful APIs.
  • Comfort reading and contributing to codebases in languages you don't own, and no fear of picking up an unfamiliar one.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices in software engineering.
  • Product thinking: an interest in the wider ecosystem and strong opinions on what is worth building.
  • A strong focus on usability and developer experience.
  • Comfort with context-switching and with a space that changes quickly.
  • A genuine interest in technology and an active interest in exploring multiple programming languages.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, including in front of customers and external partners.
  • A willingness to work as part of a remote, globally distributed team.
  • Clear thinking, self-motivation, and the ability to learn and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Experience building or operating infrastructure, and an interest in telemetry and observability (nice to have)
  • A connection to technical communities through open source projects, blogs or talks (nice to have)
  • Experience working with third-party or partner engineering teams (nice to have)
  • Prior experience of Elastic products (nice to have)

title: Sr. Software Engineer - IT Software Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Could we build a better version of an expensive SaaS tool on Elasticsearch? Our new IT Software Engineering team asks that question about the software Elastic pays for, and then we build the answer. Each system helps run the company day to day and becomes a reference architecture for Elastic's own products.

We're a team of builders, and this is a hands-on, 100% individual contributor role. Every engineer here owns their work end to end: shaping the problem, designing the system, shipping it, and keeping it healthy for years. Knowing what to build, and what not to build, matters more here than typing speed.

What this role is not: 

  • Not a front-end role. The user interface follows a shared kit and is the simplest part of the work.
  • Not a prototype or demo role. What we ship runs in production and is maintained for years.
  • Not vibe coding. We use AI to build faster, not to skip design, review or testing.
  • Not SaaS administration or configuration, and not an infrastructure-only or DevOps-only role.
  • Not a people-management role.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Take an open business problem, decide what to build and what to leave out, and turn it into a clear spec, data model and API contracts.
  • Build internal applications that replace paid, specialized tools.
  • Solve the hard parts that all of these applications share:
    • reading data from several systems of record accurately and efficiently, without overloading or slowing those systems down
    • storing sensitive data so it never leaks
    • enforcing permissions on the server, so each person sees only the records and fields they are allowed to see
  • Design and evolve the shared, versioned building blocks that every application is built from: data connectors, authorization, data storage and migrations, search, and reporting.
  • Build with AI coding agents such as Claude Code inside a disciplined, spec-driven process. Acceptance criteria are traced to tests, interface contracts get compatibility checks, and small slices are reviewed and proven before the next one starts. Automated quality gates decide when work is done.
  • Own what you build for its whole life: review, testing, releases, production operations including on-call, new features, maintenance and, eventually, retirement.
  • Help set the team's standards for architecture, contracts, testing and observability, and feed what you learn back into Elastic's products.

What You Bring 

  • Senior-level experience designing, shipping and maintaining production backend systems through failures and changing requirements, not just launching them.
  • Sound judgment about what to build, what to leave out, and how to keep a system simple as its requirements change. You apply abstraction, separation of concerns, single responsibility, SOLID and common design patterns where they fit.
  • Strong API and data design: clear contracts and careful data models, and the ability to change both without breaking the people who depend on them.
  • Experience integrating with other systems (APIs, databases, event streams) safely and efficiently.
  • Security-first thinking about authorization and sensitive data.
  • Search fundamentals. You can explain:
    • how information is indexed and how text is processed
    • how results are scored and ranked
    • when to use keyword, vector (semantic) or hybrid search
  • Strong experience in TypeScript, Python, Java or a comparable language. We build in TypeScript, and engineers from other backgrounds who want to work in TypeScript are welcome.
  • Comfort building with AI coding agents and reviewing their output skeptically. You hold yourself accountable for everything that ships.
  • You like writing specs and recording design decisions, and you let tests and checks, not claims, decide when something is done.
  • Daily, disciplined use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar) on production work.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch
  • Observability: logs, metrics, traces and alerting.
  • LLM features: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, LLM gateways and evaluations.
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer - Search Inference - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Java Developer to join our Elasticsearch team and drive our work on the Inference API in Elasticsearch.

The Elasticsearch Inference API is the integration layer between Elasticsearch and external machine learning services including Elastic's own Elastic Inference Service (EIS), third-party providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Cohere, Google), and self-hosted models. It powers features like semantic search, reranking, and generative AI across Elastic Cloud and in hosted environments.

You'll maintain and develop the plugin framework and REST API with your work spanning protocol design, streaming, async execution, billing integration, and with a tight collaboration with the wider inference team and the Kibana team.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build and maintain integrations with internal systems and external inference providers, including schema negotiation, streaming (SSE), and error normalisation
  • Contribute to the inference plugin's internal architecture: task settings, chunking strategies, rate limiting, and provider-level configuration
  • Review open source contributions to the codebase and work with third party engineers to ensure their contributions meet our technology standards
  • Participate in on-call rotation for inference-related incidents
  • Write thorough tests: unit tests using ESTestCase, YAML-based REST integration tests, and rolling-upgrade tests

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of production Java experience, with experience contributing to a large, established Java codebase. You know core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • Experience crafting ergonomic APIs and the ability to reason through tradeoffs.
  • Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.
  • Experience with ML systems
  • Contributions to and ownership of open source projects
  • Knowledge of Java build tools (Gradle, Maven, etc), with a strong preference for Gradle experience.
  • Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. What is The Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Java Developer to join our Elasticsearch team and drive our work on the Inference API in Elasticsearch.

The Elasticsearch Inference API is the integration layer between Elasticsearch and external machine learning services including Elastic's own Elastic Inference Service (EIS), third-party providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Cohere, Google), and self-hosted models. It powers features like semantic search, reranking, and generative AI across Elastic Cloud and in hosted environments.

You'll maintain and develop the plugin framework and REST API with your work spanning protocol design, streaming, async execution, billing integration, and with a tight collaboration with the wider inference team and the Kibana team.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build and maintain integrations with internal systems and external inference providers, including schema negotiation, streaming (SSE), and error normalisation
  • Contribute to the inference plugin's internal architecture: task settings, chunking strategies, rate limiting, and provider-level configuration
  • Review open source contributions to the codebase and work with third party engineers to ensure their contributions meet our technology standards
  • Participate in on-call rotation for inference-related incidents
  • Write thorough tests: unit tests using ESTestCase, YAML-based REST integration tests, and rolling-upgrade tests

What You Bring 

  • 5+ years of production Java experience, with experience contributing to a large, established Java codebase. You know core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • Experience crafting ergonomic APIs and the ability to reason through tradeoffs.
  • Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.
  • Experience with ML systems
  • Contributions to and ownership of open source projects
  • Knowledge of Java build tools (Gradle, Maven, etc), with a strong preference for Gradle experience.
  • Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team

Our Strategic Account Executives will prospect, qualify, pursue, develop and close strategic software and SaaS opportunities in assigned Fortune 250 accounts. They will develop trusted advisor level relationships with senior executives and other important decision makers and influencers, and utilize these relationships to establish Elastic as the preferred partner and create new business opportunities. Additional responsibilities will include identifying account needs and creating compelling business cases for Elastic solutions to those needs, and developing a Strategic Plan to share with internal team members, and creating coherent deal strategies and orchestrating internal team efforts to progress opportunities.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Organizational Mapping - as a companion piece to the technology landscape, the Strategic Account Executive should also document and map the organizational counterpoints across lines of business, internal IT and economic buyers for the solution areas that are relevant to Elastic. 
  • Customer Business Awareness - Actively understands each account’s strategic growth plans, technology strategy and the competitive landscape. Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to remain updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the customer
  • Driving Sales Strategy - based upon the client’s business, current technology landscape, and company business drivers the Strategic Account Executive is expected to design a plan to win new “land” business as well as “expanding” the use of Elastic software, SaaS and services. account plans should attempt to ensure revenue target delivery and balanced growth.

  • Providing Account Leadership - Create & maintain actionable account plans to guide the development of strategies and identify new business opportunities. Lead account relationships, persona profiling, and sales cycles. Effectively utilize in region and cross-functional resources to satisfy global account customers and win new business opportunities
  • Leading Business Planning – Develop and deliver a comprehensive business plan to address customer's priorities and hurdles. Use value justification, benchmarking and return-on-investment data to support decision process
  • Conducting Pipeline Planning - Follow a well-adapted approach to maintaining a rolling pipeline. Collaborate with support organizations including marketing, alliance partners and channels
  • Demonstrating Elastic Technical Proficiency – Develop technical aptitude with Elastic solutions. Be proficient with a working knowledge and understanding across all Elastic products and solutions

  • Proven track record working with American Express and / or llarge, Global Financial Services organizations as either the Global Account Manager or Strategic Account Manager

  • Knowledge of Banking and Financial Services Industry including credit card payment systems, main banking building blocks such as servicing, retail banking, fraud, audit, etc with a similar complexity level of software and/or cloud solutions

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. What is The Role

We are seeking a Principal Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch Security team. In this role, you will lead the architecture and design of Elasticsearch's main features. These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation.

You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to provide high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Owning core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Leading the technical design, plan, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
  • Developing the foundational security models for intricate features.
  • Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention.
  • Mentoring and coaching other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and security-first development.

What You Bring

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have proven experience in designing and building systems for authorization that can scale. This includes deep experience designing scalable RBAC/ABAC models and token validation pipelines. It includes permission compilation and distributed cache invalidation strategies.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance, and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions, and lead a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design and build automated marketing workflows using no-code and low-code platforms, connecting tools across the marketing tech stack so data flows reliably between systems without manual intervention.
  • Integrate marketing platforms, AI content tools, and third-party services via APIs and webhooks, handling authentication, error states, and data formatting across each connection.

descriptionHtml:

What Is The Role :

The Platform Engineering Productivity team operates the CI, CD, and Release infrastructure for the company. We ensure developers can efficiently and safely deploy changes across our various environments and at scale. In an age of AI, the landscape is evolving rapidly from scaling needs to, more than ever, securing our supply chain. There are interesting challenges to tackle.   We're looking for a proactive systems thinker who delivers on business-driven projects while identifying and driving the work that keeps our infrastructure ahead before scaling and security challenges become problems. If you're energized by work that makes every engineering team at Elastic ship faster and more securely, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Define the roadmap and technical vision for CI/CD, from problem identification through org-wide adoption.
  • Identify where CI/CD is a bottleneck, a source of friction, or a security risk before it becomes an incident, and drive the remediation rather than waiting to be assigned it.
  • Design and enforce release gates covering supply chain integrity, artifact provenance, and release readiness, built to scale across teams without becoming a tax on engineering velocity.
  • Direct engineers on your team through complex, multi-quarter projects: break down the architecture, assign the work, and own the outcome even when the execution is distributed.
  • Drive clear technical communication and alignment across teams, and produce high-quality documentation for systems, processes, and architectural decisions.
  • Serve as Incident Commander on high-severity supply chain or release incidents, and use each incident as a forcing function for structural improvements.
  • Raise the engineering bar across the org through code review, mentorship, design review, and by setting standards others adopt voluntarily.
  • Remain hands-on at the right depth: you'll review code, prototype approaches, and debug production issues, but your primary leverage at this level is through the work of others, not your own output.

What You Bring :

  • Deep expertise in CI/CD and what it takes to harden a release pipeline against supply chain attacks.
  • Strong debugging instincts across the full pipeline stack: you trace failures from test runner to artifact store to cluster deployment without needing a specialist for each layer.
  • Hands-on with CI infrastructure (Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or equivalent), GitOps/ArgoCD, and Kubernetes.
  • You use AI to accelerate your own work and your team's and you understand AI's impact on supply chain security and scale.
  • A track record of multi-quarter, cross-org ownership: you've identified the right problem, designed the solution, and gotten organizations that didn't report to you to change how they work.
  • The judgment to push back on a prescribed plan when it's the wrong call, and the credibility to get alignment on a better approach.
  • Experience directing the work of other engineers toward outcomes not just collaborating, but breaking down complex problems into executable work and holding the outcome.

What is The Role

As a Senior Incident Response Analyst at Elastic, you are one of the front-line defenders for ensuring we are delivering safe and secure products and services to our customers, users, and fellow Elasticians. You will be responsible for reviewing and responding to alerts across a wide variety of sources that include multiple cloud providers, CI/CD environments, SaaS services, user workstations, and much more. Elastic is distributed globally by design, and we model our response practice around that same concept; enabling domain experts to respond with oversight from the Incident Response team and relying on you to provide oversight and guidance to these experts. You’ll also dive in and provide support in identifying what happened, who did it, when, and where to ensure we’ve accurately secured our environment during and after security events. If doing all of this with the Elastic Stack excites you, then we’d love to talk with you!

What You Will Be Doing

  • Review and respond to alerts generated from our Elastic Detection Engine and other monitoring sources
  • Provide feedback to the Threat Detection team to improve the quality of detections by identifying false positives, enrichment opportunities, and automated response possibilities
  • Conduct analysis on SIEM and/or endpoint logs during complex investigations
  • Develop and document innovative approaches to detect, respond to, and eradicate advanced threats and improve overall time to respond
  • Identify additional integration points that would aid in event enrichment and enable automated response activities
  • Gather additional context for security events
  • Identify the root cause of events and collaborate with teams to remediate any identified control gaps or failures
  • Oversee and coordinate response activities that span multiple teams and products to ensure comprehensive remediation and sufficient mitigation of any identified gaps in security posture

What You Bring 

  • At least 3 years of experience related to security operations / incident response in a complex, global environment. SaaS and cloud experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve complex IT and security problems through log and system analysis (Incident Response, SRE, System Administration). If you’ve done this with the help of the Elastic Stack, even better!

title: Senior Engineer, Competitive Benchmarking & Performance
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team. 

You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.
  • Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.
  • Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.
  • Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.
  • Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.
  • Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.
  • Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.
  • Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.
  • Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring 

  • Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.
  • Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.
  • Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.
  • Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.
  • Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.
  • Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.
  • Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.
  • Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.
  • Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.
  • Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

  • Successfully designed and launched multiple user interface components that significantly increased user commitment
  • You should have experience using AI-assisted development tools. These tools can help you develop features faster, fix complex systems, and improve existing codebases.

  • A multiplier mindset ! you make the engineers around you better.
  • A generalist streak and a user-focused mindset, with consideration for the people using your software.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the Elastic stack, observability tooling, or log/data-ingestion pipelines.
  • Go, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development experience.
  • Experience building large user interfaces that manage a lot of data. This includes skills in search, filtering, and tables. You should also have experience working with streaming or real-time data.
  • Prior open-source / working-in-the-open experience, or time on a developer-facing platform team.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team.

What Is The Role
Elastic is looking for a driven, results-oriented Enterprise Account Executive to accelerate growth in Singapore. The ideal candidate is a proven hunter with a strong track record of acquiring new enterprise customers, building pipeline from the ground up, and closing complex technology deals with large organizations. This role is suited to a sales professional who thrives on winning new logos, breaking into strategic accounts, and establishing relationships with senior business and technology leaders. You will identify new market opportunities, develop compelling business cases, and position Elastic as a strategic technology partner to enterprise customers. You will own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and qualifying opportunities to developing deal strategies, negotiating commercial agreements, and closing new business. While new customer acquisition is the primary focus, you will also identify opportunities to expand Elastic's footprint within existing accounts.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Acquire New Enterprise Customers: Identify, target, and win new enterprise logos in Singapore. Develop and execute a proactive territory strategy to penetrate strategic accounts and establish Elastic's presence in new customer environments.
  • Build Pipeline Through Prospecting: Generate qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound prospecting, executive networking, referrals, partner relationships, industry events, and other demand-generation activities. Maintain a strong pipeline of self-sourced opportunities.
  • Own the Full Sales Cycle: Lead complex enterprise sales engagements from initial discovery and qualification through solution development, business case creation, negotiation, and deal closure.
  • Develop Executive Relationships: Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, business leaders, and senior technology stakeholders. Understand their strategic priorities and connect Elastic's solutions to measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive Competitive Wins: Identify opportunities to displace incumbent vendors, challenge the status quo, and introduce Elastic into new accounts. Develop compelling value propositions and differentiated sales strategies to win competitive opportunities.
  • Develop Strategic Account Plans: Create actionable territory and account plans that identify target customers, buying centers, key stakeholders, whitespace opportunities, and clear paths to winning new business.
  • Lead Complex Enterprise Deals: Orchestrate cross-functional teams across solution architecture, product, professional services, marketing, and channel partners to advance opportunities and deliver successful customer outcomes.
  • Build Business Value: Translate customer challenges into compelling business cases supported by value justification, ROI analysis, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive Partner-Led Growth: Work closely with channel partners, systems integrators, cloud providers, and strategic alliances to identify new opportunities, expand market reach, and accelerate customer acquisition.
  • Deliver Consistent Sales Performance: Own pipeline creation, forecast accuracy, sales execution, and quota attainment. Maintain a disciplined approach to qualification, deal progression, and territory management.
  • Develop Elastic Expertise: Build a strong working knowledge of Elastic's Search AI, Observability, and Security solutions, and articulate their value to enterprise customers across different industries.

What You Bring

  • Proven Hunter Mentality: A demonstrated track record of winning new enterprise customers, opening doors in target accounts, and building pipeline through proactive prospecting rather than relying primarily on inbound leads or inherited accounts.
  • Enterprise Technology Sales Experience: At least 8–10 years of successful B2B technology sales experience, ideally selling enterprise software, SaaS, cloud, data, cybersecurity, or observability solutions to large organizations.
  • New Logo Acquisition Success: Evidence of consistently acquiring new customers, penetrating greenfield accounts, and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals.
  • Strong Pipeline Generation Skills: The ability and willingness to prospect, create demand, engage previously untapped stakeholders, and convert cold or early-stage opportunities into qualified pipeline and closed revenue.
  • Complex Deal Execution: Proven experience managing multi-stakeholder sales cycles, navigating enterprise procurement processes, negotiating commercial agreements, and closing seven-figure opportunities.
  • Executive Presence: Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence senior business and technology decision-makers.
  • Value-Based Selling: The ability to uncover business challenges, articulate differentiated value propositions, and build compelling business cases that connect technology investments to business outcomes.
  • Competitive Drive: A track record of winning against established competitors, displacing incumbent solutions, and overcoming customer resistance to change.
  • Territory and Account Planning: Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to prioritize target accounts, identify buying centers, develop account strategies, and manage a healthy pipeline.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: The ability to mobilize internal teams and external partners across functions and geographies to progress complex deals and win new business.
  • SaaS and Subscription Knowledge: Familiarity with enterprise software licensing, SaaS commercial models, cloud marketplaces, and subscription-based selling.
  • Ownership and Resilience: A self-starter who demonstrates urgency, accountability, curiosity, and persistence in a competitive sales environment. Comfortable creating opportunities where no established customer relationship exists.

To support our growth and enable us to scale proficiently, we are seeking a impressive Sales Ops Professional to drive all sales strategy, planning, reporting, and analysis efforts for our ESP org.  We're looking for a Sr. Analyst, RevOps to help us harness data to provide insights for our business partners, support regular business reviews, and assist in annual planning activities. This role offers the chance to play a significant part in shaping important areas that can drive growth for Elastic in the market, particularly as our organization is still developing its capabilities. If you enjoy working in a dynamic environment where your contributions can have a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to uncover insights that drive revenue growth. Develop data models and create dashboards to monitor key performance metrics proficiently. Identify trends and patterns in data, supporting business decisions while assisting with data validation and quality assurance to maintain data integrity.
  • Develop robust revenue forecasting models based on historical data. Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to gather insights that inform forecasts. Monitor actual revenue against forecasts and adjust models as needed. Clearly communicate findings and assumptions to stakeholders to ensure alignment.
  • Evaluate the current RevOps processes to identify and eliminate inefficiencies. Design and implement improvements that enhance operational efficiency. Facilitate workshops across departments to streamline workflows and establish best practices for data collection and reporting.
  • Collaborate with business partners to identify their reporting and analytical needs. Facilitate cross-functional meetings to gather insights and align on RevOps initiatives. Build well-developed relationships with stakeholders for effective communication and provide training on data usage and insights interpretation.
  • Create and maintain regular performance reports to track key revenue metrics. Examine the data to identify improvement areas and growth opportunities. Present actionable recommendations to stakeholders and collaborate with IT to optimize reporting tools for user needs.
  • Deliver strategic insights through data analysis to fuel business growth initiatives. Clearly present findings to senior management and evaluate risks tied to revenue strategies, recommending effective mitigations. Build actionable plans that assist business partners in making informed decisions.

What You Bring 

  • 3-5 years work experience in Sales Operations, Strategy, FP&A, Management Consulting, or similar field in SaaS organizations
  • Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation techniques
  • Ability to evaluate and improve RevOps processes
  • Experience with data validation and quality assurance practices
  • Ability to use analytical software for trend identification
  • Experience in collaborating with CRM systems
  • Knowledge of SaaS business metrics and performance indicators
  • Proficiency with effective use of AI for operations use cases
  • Demonstrated ability to streamline RevOps processes leading to measurable efficiency gains
  • History of fostering well-developed relationships with stakeholders
  • Accomplished in delivering strategic insights that informed senior management's revenue initiatives
  • Proven ability to present complex data findings in a clear and actionable manner to diverse audiences

descriptionHtml:

What Is The Role: We are looking for a Principal who understands how marketing and sales work collectively to create revenue. You’ll be the architect, the builder, and the link between the business and the systems that serve it. You’ll learn what decisions leaders face, form a point of view on which systems, tools, and products are worth building or buying, and make the case for it with clear reasoning. You’ll also build the data models and analysis that deliver the value. You’ll partner with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Data teams, and you’ll mentor senior analysts and engineers. Your role is to help the business answer where to invest, which accounts to pursue, and what drives revenue.
  • Meet with business leaders to understand their problems and decisions. Turn them into analyses, recommended actions, and clear requirements for systems and data.
  • Recommend which systems, tools, and products to prioritize, with a clear point of view and the reasoning behind it.
  • Build the business case for each investment: expected value, required resources, and total cost of ownership. Present it to leaders and gain agreement.
  • Design the overall architecture for marketing and sales measurement, and build the core data models, pipelines, and machine learning datasets, with testing and version control.
  • Build models that show how marketing spend and activity convert to pipeline and revenue, and measure the full customer path from first touch to closed deal.
  • Define account-based performance measures and apply them with Sales and Marketing.
  • Combine attribution, incrementality, and mix modeling into one consistent view of what works.
  • Build tools that let marketers ask questions in plain language and get trusted answers.
  • Set standards for metric definitions, data quality, and privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA), and keep them consistent across Sales, Marketing, and systems teams.
  • Plan roadmaps and milestones with Data Engineering, Analytics, and IT.
  • Mentor senior analysts and engineers.
What You Bring:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a quantitative or technical field, such as Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or Computer Science.
  • 10+ years in marketing or GTM analytics at a B2B company.
  • Experience designing data and analytics architecture, and recommending which tools and platforms to build, buy, or retire.
  • Experience building business cases, including cost, value, and total cost of ownership, and influencing senior leaders to reach agreement.
  • A consultative style. You can uncover business pain points and turn them into analysis plans that lead to decisions.
  • Funnel economics and performance modeling experience across sales and marketing data.
  • Experience with account-based strategy, motions, and frameworks, and with marketing lifecycle and deal lifecycle analytics.
  • Proficient presentation skills, with the ability to explain methods, trade-offs, and results to executives and non-technical teams.
  • Extensive SQL and dbt (or similar), data modeling, and cloud data warehouse experience, preferably BigQuery.
  • Python or R skills, with clean, tested code.
  • Hands-on experience with attribution, incrementality testing, and/or marketing mix modeling, plus applied statistics.
  • Knowledge of machine learning models, and the ability to help build and use them in production.
  • Experience mentoring and developing others.
Bonus Points:
  • Experience with Salesforce, Marketo, or similar GTM systems data.
  • Experience across PLG, SLG, ABM, and Enterprise sales motions.
  • Experience building natural language question-and-answer tools for business data.
  • Privacy-first and cookieless measurement experience.
