title: Senior Java Engineer - Security - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Elasticsearch Security team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture and design of Elasticsearch's main features. These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to participate in providing high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Participating in the technical design, planning, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
  • Developing the foundational security models for features.
  • Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention.

What You Bring

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have experience building authorization systems that are scalable and performant under high concurrency and large permission sets, including designing access models, validating credentials/tokens at scale, and keeping authorization decisions consistent across a distributed system.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still collaborating on the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, supporting decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

The Marketing Innovation team at Elastic is responsible for developing and maintaining innovative internal applications that improve marketing efficiency and execution. Our flagship app is a homegrown platform crafted to integrate campaign planning, performance reporting, automation, and audience management.

We’re seeking a Full Stack Technical Developer with a backend focus to join our team as a proficient contributor, working closely with Technical Program Managers (TPMs) and users to help bring our roadmap to life.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Build and maintain backend services, RESTful APIs, and database structures that power our internal
    marketing applications.
    • Translate business requirements from marketers and TPMs into reliable, intuitive full-stack features, applying sound judgment within established team practices and procedures.
    • Contribute to the technical implementation of features from the database up to the API layer, while working in the frontend codebase (React/TypeScript).
    • Collaborate with frontend-focused engineers and infrastructure teams to ensure smooth system integration and development lifecycle.

title: Senior Services Sales Executive, Strategic Accounts — Americas West
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

At Elastic, we believe that search is more than just a box—it's a way to solve the world's most complex data challenges. As a Senior Services Sales Executive for our Strategic Accounts segment, you will be the primary driver of professional services growth across our highest-value relationships in the Americas West. This is a quota-carrying sales role: you own the full services sales cycle—from pipeline origination through commercial close—across a portfolio of Global 500 and industry-leading accounts.

You are not just a trusted advisor; you are a closer. You arrive with an established network of senior relationships in the strategic segment—and you know how to activate them. You translate executive credibility and long-standing trust into pipeline, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and convert ambitious customer goals into scoped, commercially sound multi-million dollar engagement programs. You partner closely with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to embed services as a strategic pillar of every account plan, and you work hand-in-hand with our delivery leaders to ensure what you sell lands with exceptional outcomes.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own Your Number: Carry and consistently achieve a services bookings quota across a named portfolio of Strategic accounts. Build and maintain a healthy, stage-accurate pipeline with strong forecast discipline in Salesforce.
  • Drive New Business: Proactively identify and originate services opportunities within existing accounts and new-to-services logos. You don't wait for the phone to ring—you map whitespace, uncover initiatives, and create demand.
  • Lead the Full Services Sales Cycle: Run discovery, lead solutioning sessions, develop Statements of Work, structure creative commercial arrangements (T&M, fixed-fee, milestone-based), negotiate terms, and close. You own this process end-to-end.
  • Sell Complex, Multi-Year Engagements: Architect and sell multi-phase, multi-million dollar programs tied to customers' largest transformation bets—modernization initiatives, platform migrations, security programs, and AI/analytics buildouts.
  • Activate and Expand Your Network: You bring an established book of executive relationships in the strategic segment—and you put them to work. From day one, you leverage existing trust with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, and SVPs of Engineering to open doors, accelerate pipeline, and land early wins. Over time, you deepen those relationships and expand your reach into new stakeholders within the accounts you own.
  • Partner with the Field: Work side-by-side with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to co-develop account plans, align on services investment strategies, and present a unified value story to customers. You amplify—not duplicate—the field team. We are not order takers, but rather help shape the larger Elastic strategy with our customers.
  • Develop Compelling Business Cases: Lead ROI conversations and construct value frameworks that link Elastic's services investments to measurable customer outcomes—reduced time-to-value, improved MTTD/MTTR, lower operational costs, faster platform adoption.
  • Shape Engagements for Delivery Success: Collaborate with Services Delivery leadership to scope engagements that are both winnable and deliverable. You set your customers and delivery teams up to succeed from day one.
  • Contribute to Practice Growth: Share field intelligence on buyer patterns, competitive dynamics, and packaging gaps to help Elastic continuously sharpen its services offerings for the Strategic market.

What You Bring

  • A Proven Services Sales Track Record: 10+ years of quota-carrying professional services sales experience, with consistent attainment selling into enterprise or strategic/global accounts. You have personally originated and closed multi-million dollar services engagements.
  • An Established Network You Can Activate: You bring pre-existing executive relationships in the Global 500 / strategic segment—and a track record of converting those relationships into revenue. You don't need to spend your first year earning introductions; you arrive ready to open conversations and move deals.
  • Strategic Account Depth: Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of complex, high-stakes accounts—not just renewing, but growing. You know what it takes to be trusted at the executive level over the long term, and you've done it.
  • Commercial Sophistication: You are fluent in services deal structures—T&M, fixed-fee, managed services, subscription-based delivery models. You've negotiated Master Services Agreements, SOWs, and custom commercial terms with procurement and legal teams.
  • Solutioning Credibility: You can lead technical scoping conversations. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you can translate customer architecture goals into realistic, well-scoped engagement plans that earn buy-in from both the buyer and the delivery team.
  • Executive Presence: You are comfortable and effective in C-suite conversations. You ask sharp discovery questions, listen actively, and earn a seat at the table—not just a slot on the agenda.
  • Pipeline Discipline: You build pipeline with intention and manage it rigorously. You forecast accurately, move deals with urgency, and never let momentum die on the customer's side.
  • Field Collaboration: You thrive in a co-selling model. You know how to align with AEs, SEs, CSMs, and delivery leaders to drive the right outcome for the account—without ego or turf.
  • Curiosity for the Technology: You don't need to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about how the technology works—and you invest in understanding it. You'll take the time to learn Elastic's platform, speak credibly about search, observability, and security use cases, and hold your own in conversations with technical buyers to earn you a seat at the table.
  • Domain Relevance: Experience selling services in the search, observability, security, data analytics, or broader enterprise software space strongly preferred. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern data architectures is a plus.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field. MBA or similar advanced degree is a plus.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 80/20 pay mix (base salary / target variable).  

The typical starting OTE range for new hires in this role is listed below.  This range represents the lowest to highest OTE we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.  

An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

The Finance Transformation Manager will design, scale, and automate the financial systems and operational processes required to support our quote-to-cash (Q2C) processes. This role acts as the bridge between Corporate Finance, Deal Desk, Order Operations, and IT. You will lead initiatives across pricing and deal structuring, CPQ, order management, billing, revenue recognition, and collections.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) transformation planning, execution, and governance.
  • Define program scope, work-streams, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.
  • Drive transformation across pricing/CPQ, deal structuring, contracting, order management, billing, revenue recognition, and collections.
  • Manage third-party vendors and system integrators supporting CPQ, billing, contract management, and revenue recognition initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and standardize Q2C processes across the enterprise.

What You Bring

  • 6-8+ years of experience in Program Management, Finance Transformation, Order/Billing Operations, or Revenue Operations.
  • Proven experience leading complex enterprise transformation programs from strategy/problem definition through implementation.
  • Deep understanding of the entire Quote-to-Cash lifecycle including applicable operational experience.
  • Experience working across multiple business functions including Finance, Sales Operations, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Accounting, and IT.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive results across teams without direct authority.
  • Solid program governance, planning, execution, risk management, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to convert data into actionable business insights.
  • Transformation Track Record: Proven experience leading large-scale software integrations or Q2C transformation cycles in a B2B SaaS or enterprise tech environment.
  • Quote-to-Cash Knowledge: Deep knowledge of end-to-end quote-to-cash (Q2C) processes, preferably in a software or SaaS environment
  • CRM, ERP & Revenue Systems: Advanced knowledge of enterprise CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite), and revenue recognition systems (e.g., Zuora RevPro).

They also oversee the shared patterns, tokens, and tools that ensure Elastic products are consistent, accessible, and high-quality.   You will work closely with the team's Tech Lead, who is in charge of the technical direction and architecture. You will oversee the people, roadmap, and delivery aspects of the team. This means hiring and developing engineers, creating a realistic roadmap, and ensuring the team aligns with Design leadership and Product Management on what gets built and when.   We are looking for an Engineering Manager with experience leading design system or platform teams. The ideal candidate knows how to balance long-term investments with ongoing requests from other teams. They should also be able to create a dependable delivery schedule for the whole organization.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Manage and grow a team of engineers responsible for building and maintaining Elastic UI (EUI) and other shared design system infrastructure across Global UX.
  • Own the team's delivery cadence - sprint planning, quarterly roadmap, outcomes, and status reporting to stakeholders across Elastic.
  • Run hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career growth for engineers on the team.
  • Build strong team culture and health in a fully distributed, async-first environment.
  • Represent Global UX in cross-functional planning with other engineering, design, and product leadership across Elastic.
  • Remove blockers for the team: negotiate dependencies with other teams, address organizational friction, and escalate risks early.
  • Track adoption and health metrics for the design system (usage, satisfaction, migration progress) and use them to inform roadmap priorities.
  • Build relationships with teams that consume the design system, gathering feedback and making sure their needs shape the roadmap.
  • Support the team's experiments with AI-assisted design-to-code workflows and developer tools. Balance innovation with delivery commitments.

What You Bring 

  • Previous experience managing engineering teams that build and maintain design systems, component libraries, or similarly widely-consumed shared UI or platform infrastructure.
  • Experience running delivery cadence - sprint planning, quarterly planning, roadmapping, and outcomes for a team that serves many internal stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of frontend engineering (React, TypeScript, component architecture) sufficient to make credible technical tradeoffs alongside your Tech Lead and engineers.
  • Experience hiring, developing, and retaining engineers, with a track record of growing people into more senior roles.
  • Robust stakeholder management skills. Comfortable sharing the roadmap, tradeoffs, and risks with engineering, design, and product leaders.
  • A track record of balancing platform and foundational investment against the urgent feature requests of consuming teams.
  • Deep written and verbal communication skills, with experience working in a distributed, async-first team.
  • Experience using data and adoption metrics (usage, satisfaction, migration progress) to inform roadmap decisions.
  • A collaborative leadership style that earns trust from your engineering team without needing to be the most technical person in the room.
  • Curiosity about how AI is changing design-to-code workflows and developer tooling, and comfort helping a team adopt new practices responsibly.

descriptionHtml:

Elastic is seeking a dynamic Federal Account Executive. As an integral part of our growth strategy, you will play a key role in driving our expansion and net-new revenue within the United States Postal Service (USPS) and related logistics, operational, and civilian stakeholder ecosystems. This is an opportunity for a high-performing public sector sales professional passionate about empowering large-scale civilian operations through groundbreaking AI-powered search, analytics, and security technology, enabling them to unlock the full potential of massive, distributed mission data.

What Is The Role

Joining our GEO of the Year-winning Public Sector team, Elastic is seeking a results-oriented Federal Account Executive to lead and scale our footprint across the United States Postal Service (USPS)—one of the largest, most technologically complex, and highly distributed enterprise logistics networks in the world.

This is an extraordinary opportunity for a quota-carrying federal seller to drive large-scale adoption of AI-powered search, log analytics, SIEM/XDR, and full-stack observability across mission-critical postal operations, package tracking, digital infrastructure, and inspection services. You will spearhead high-visibility pursuits to modernize legacy IT environments, ensure high system availability for vital national logistics platforms, help postal IT and security leadership comply with federal mandates (including Zero Trust and OMB M-21-31), and displace costly, incumbent SIEM and legacy monitoring tools across the USPS infrastructure.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive Strategic Adoption: Expand the footprint of Elastic’s Search AI, Observability, and Security solutions across key USPS directorates, including IT Operations, Enterprise Analytics, Supply Chain/Logistics Systems, and the USPS Office of Inspector General (OIG) / Postal Inspection Service (USPIS).

  • Capitalize on Competitive Displacements: Execute disciplined land-and-expand strategies to replace legacy monitoring and SIEM providers (e.g., Splunk), empowering USPS to dramatically lower total cost of ownership (TCO) while operating at unprecedented scale.

  • Act as a Trusted Advisor: Partner closely with postal leadership, enterprise architects, network operations, and CISO/CIO teams to solve critical operational bottlenecks using AI-driven search, real-time log ingestion, application performance monitoring (APM), and threat detection.

  • Execute Complex FedCiv Sales Cycles: Uncover whitespace and program funding, navigate agency-specific procurement vehicles and federal schedules (GSA, NASA SEWP, agency BPAs), and manage multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial discovery through contract award and consumption expansion.

  • Master Mutual Deal Strategy & Qualification: Apply rigorous sales qualification frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC) to build repeatable close plans, accurately forecasting quarterly and annual performance in Salesforce (SFDC) within ±10%.

  • Build Strategic Ecosystem Coalitions: Build comprehensive pursuit plans aligned with key Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs), postal prime contractors, VARs, and hyperscale cloud partners (AWS, Azure, GCP) to accelerate deal velocity.

  • Champion the Elastic Model: Articulate the business and mission value of Elastic’s commercial features, managed services, and FedRAMP authorized cloud environments while leveraging our foundational open-source roots and developer community.

What You Bring

  • Proven Federal Quota-Carrying Success: 5+ years of closing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals selling software, SaaS, or consumption-based cloud solutions into Federal Civilian (FedCiv) or quasi-governmental enterprise environments, with a consistent history of quota overachievement.

  • Direct USPS / Civ Agency Experience: Prior track record selling into the United States Postal Service (USPS) or closely adjacent large-scale civilian logistics/operations environments, with established relationships among postal buyers, decision-makers, and key delivery primes.

  • Technical & Domain Fluency: Strong functional understanding of Enterprise Search, Log Analytics, SIEM/SOC operations, APM, Observability, and hybrid-cloud/distributed architectures.

  • Value-Based Storytelling: Exceptional ability to translate complex technology capabilities into real-world business outcomes—mapping Search AI directly to reduced downtime, risk mitigation, fraud prevention, and operational efficiency.

  • Procurement & Contract Acumen: Proven ability to structure and negotiate multi-year, multi-million-dollar contracts, navigate federal procurement pathways, and partner with channel ecosystems.

  • Predictable Pipeline Management: Discipline in self-sourcing pipeline, maintaining active pipeline coverage (≥3–4x), and driving disciplined CRM hygiene.

  • Collaborative & Coachable Mindset: A team-first seller who partners seamlessly with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Legal, and RevOps to orchestrate cohesive account pursuits.

  • Career Growth & Stability: A demonstrated track record of career progression, sustained tenure, and proven dependability within technology sales organizations.

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience displacing legacy SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, QRadar) or legacy APM/infrastructure tools in large federal civilian or enterprise accounts.

  • Familiarity with federal security frameworks, Zero Trust architectures, OMB M-21-31 logging compliance, and FedRAMP cloud deployments.

  • Existing relationships within the major prime contractors and technology integrators supporting USPS IT and logistics infrastructure.

  • Prior experience with open-source software, developer-led motions, or consumption/usage-based commercial models.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

Every outcome on the Elastic platform starts with data getting in. Streams, Elastic’s telemetry pipeline, is the shared ingest layer for Observability, Security, and Search. It collects data from any source, processes and routes it, and stores it in Elasticsearch or the customer’s own object storage, all built on open standards like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. As Director of Product Management, you will own Streams end to end and lead the PM team behind it. Your job is to make Elastic the easiest platform to bring data to, for every solution and every customer.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for data collection, ingestion, processing and routing, and the integrations framework.
  • Define and track KPIs focused on product and feature adoption
  • Partner with Observability, Security, and Search product leaders to provide a shared service everyone can leverage
  • Make getting data ingestion self-service, with time-to-first-data measured in minutes.
  • Lead a team of distributed product managers and enable them to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Drive roadmap priorities by working with customers, internal teams, and the community
  • Work with engineers and designers to scope and define compelling features
  • Enable sales, marketing, and partners with clear messaging and positioning

What You Bring 

  • 10+ years in product management, including 4+ years leading PM teams in data infrastructure, observability, or data pipelines.
  • Deep technical fluency in telemetry ingest: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, log processing, routing, and agent management.
  • Experience shipping SaaS products with usage-based pricing, and building platform capabilities shared by several product lines.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

  Are you looking to make a real impact and play a meaningful role in the growth of our company?   The Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) multiplies Elastic's technical reach through partners. An account SA wins one deal at a time. You build technical capability across a focused group of partners (SIs, resellers, MSSPs, cloud providers) so they can source pipeline, win deals, and deliver Elastic on their own.   The role has three pillars: drive partner-sourced pipeline; multiply technical capacity and co-build repeatable solutions.   You will work a defined portfolio of managed partners, each with an agreed technical engagement plan, and be measured on outputs, partner sourced deals, committed engagement plans and published assets, not on activity volume but impact.   Prior presales experience in the software sector is required for this role in the US Public Sector. It is a sales-aligned position that carries a partner-sourced pipeline target and candidates should plan for up to 30% travel.  

What you will be doing

  Drive growth with and through partners
  • Generate approved partner deal registrations, jointly owned with Partner Managers for your territory.
  • Run partner-tailored sales playbooks on registered deals: qualify the deal shape, support intake and technical scoping, and help partners attach their own services, lifting average deal size.
  • Accelerate partner-led opportunities, hands-on labs and proofs of concept, in collaboration with account AEs and SAs.
  • Stays current on competitive dynamics and market trends, equipping partners with sharp "Why Elastic" positioning over competing vendors
Architect of leverage
  • Own the technical relationships and named champions at each partner in your portfolio; build trusted advisor status with senior technical stakeholders.
  • Create, commit and maintain a Technical Engagement Plan per focus partner, the technical section of the Joint Business Plan, and run quarterly read-outs with the partner, Partner Manager and other stakeholders.
  • Deliver enablement and certification roadmaps, accreditations & certifications, that move partners up a defined technical maturity model.
  • Leads hands-on technical lab workshops across Elastic products, building partner technical confidence and solution fluency
Co-innovate on repeatable solutions
  • Co-architect solution blueprints and reference architectures with partners, including hyperscalers.
  • Build reusable demos, sales cards and battlecards partners can run without Elastic in the room; co-publish reference win stories and joint blog posts.
  • Authors customer-facing content including white papers, blogs, and sales collateral, informed by market trends and deep relationships with partner technical leaders
  • Supports technical deployments of Elastic in partner labs, demonstration environments, and testing grounds

What you bring

  • 2+ years e in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting and/or cloud/infrastructure technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1+ years of pre-sales experience in the software sector, ideally partner-facing: channel, alliances, SI/GSI or MSSP ecosystems in the US Public Sector.
  • A one-to-many mindset: you would rather teach ten engineers to run the demo than run it ten times yourself, and you can show where your enablement turned into someone else's win.
  • Working knowledge of security operations (SIEM, endpoint, cloud security) and/or observability, plus an understanding of AI and semantic search technologies.
  • Professional experience architecting or operating solutions on AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.
  • Commercial fluency: you can read a deal, discuss services scope and margin with a partner, and translate technical capability into the business case their customer buys.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a self-starter's bias to action; you inspire partner teams to work on what is most relevant, not just what is urgent.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay focused and deliver results amid ambiguity, distractions, and competing priorities.
  • Comfortable operating both collaboratively across partner and cross-functional teams and independently to execute a plan and deliver results
  • Skilled at leading through influence, aligning partners and internal stakeholders around shared priorities and goals
  • Technical experience in at least one Elastic solution area is highly desired (AI agents & Search, security operations, or observability); cross-domain fluency across all three is a differentiator
  • Must be able to travel to partner offices, events, and conferences in support of partner activities; approximately 30% travel expected
  • Must be located in the Washington DC Metro area
Bonus Points
  • Meaningful, demonstratable, experience with AI/ML technologies, including exposure to LLMs, embeddings, vector search, or agentic AI frameworks
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation, integration, or demonstration purposes
  • Prior experience in a technical training, instruction, or curriculum development capacity is a plus

  • Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.

  • Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including observability, security, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.

  • Collaborative mindset & coachability: A learner who partners effectively with internal teams, incorporates feedback, and embodies Elastic’s values of community and openness.

  • Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

  • Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

title: Principal Product Manager II, AI/Vectors - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and roadmap for Elastic's embedding/reranking and vector database and related capabilities. In this senior role, you'll be the go-to expert on search/vector search, guiding the direction for technologies like vector indexing and hybrid retrieval. This position offers the chance to shape a vital part of our product, working closely with engineering and research teams to ensure that our offerings meet the needs of numerous organizations while keeping pace with the evolving landscape of AI.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Conduct market research to uncover emerging trends in search/vector databases as well as SOTA model research in emerging areas to manage unstructured data, working alongside our model team.
  • Evaluate the competitive landscape to enhance product positioning and develop user personas that guide feature decisions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align the product strategy with business goals while prioritizing features based on customer feedback and market demands.
  • Establish long-term product goals and milestones for the vector use cases, document AI and unstructured data management to drive its development. Prioritize features and enhancements based on user feedback and technical feasibility. Allocate resources skillfully to ensure timely updates, while coordinating with engineering teams to validate roadmap assumptions. Communicate updates and expectations clearly to stakeholders and executives.
  • Own the vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Elastic's vector database as well as core search use cases, from low-level indexing internals to the developer-facing APIs and SDKs.
  • Partner deeply with engineering and applied research on trade-offs, be a credible technical peer in those conversations. Define and defend the metrics that matter: recall, latency, index size, ingestion throughput, and total cost of ownership. Advance the competitiveness of Elastic AI and Vector products across all deployments - Serverless and Self-managed.
  • Define a unified strategy and roadmap across embedding/reranking models and vector indexing/ semantic ingestion, model lifecycle, and end-to-end retrieval quality.
  • Manage the operating cadence. Make sure shared metrics and priorities align the research, cloud, and engineering teams. Address trade-offs where model and index decisions intersect.

What You Bring 

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • Master's degree in a relevant discipline preferred
  • 8+ years in product management, with significant time on technical infrastructure, databases, search, or ML/AI platforms.
  • You should have good working knowledge of vector search fundamentals. This includes embeddings, ANN indexing, similarity metrics, and trade-offs between recall and latency. Additionally, you need to know about hybrid retrieval.
  • You should have a working knowledge of generative models, model fine tuning, model capabilities and document processing for large corpus
  • You don't need to be a researcher, but you should hold your own with engineers on these topics. A track record of shipping developer- or infrastructure-facing products that were adopted at scale.

title: Senior Engineer, Competitive Benchmarking & Performance
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team. 

You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.
  • Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.
  • Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.
  • Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.
  • Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.
  • Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.
  • Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.
  • Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.
  • Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring 

  • Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.
  • Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.
  • Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.
  • Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.
  • Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.
  • Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.
  • Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.
  • Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.
  • Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.
  • Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team. 

You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.
  • Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.
  • Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.
  • Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.
  • Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.
  • Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.
  • Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.
  • Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.
  • Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring 

  • Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.
  • Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.
  • Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.
  • Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.
  • Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.
  • Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.
  • Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.
  • Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.
  • Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.
  • Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.
  • Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

Every outcome on the Elastic platform starts with data getting in. Streams, Elastic’s telemetry pipeline, is the shared ingest layer for Observability, Security, and Search. It collects data from any source, processes and routes it, and stores it in Elasticsearch or the customer’s own object storage, all built on open standards like OpenTelemetry and Prometheus. As Director of Product Management, you will own Streams end to end and lead the PM team behind it. Your job is to make Elastic the easiest platform to bring data to, for every solution and every customer.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for data collection, ingestion, processing and routing, and the integrations framework.
  • Define and track KPIs focused on product and feature adoption
  • Partner with Observability, Security, and Search product leaders to provide a shared service everyone can leverage
  • Make getting data ingestion self-service, with time-to-first-data measured in minutes.
  • Lead a team of distributed product managers and enable them to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Drive roadmap priorities by working with customers, internal teams, and the community
  • Work with engineers and designers to scope and define compelling features
  • Enable sales, marketing, and partners with clear messaging and positioning

What You Bring 

  • 10+ years in product management, including 4+ years leading PM teams in data infrastructure, observability, or data pipelines.
  • Deep technical fluency in telemetry ingest: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, log processing, routing, and agent management.
  • Experience shipping SaaS products with usage-based pricing, and building platform capabilities shared by several product lines.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - Observability APM UI
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. What is The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our APM UI team, where you'll have the chance to shape and enhance our user interface, making it more intuitive and engaging for our users. In this role, you'll work on Kibana and the UI components helping application developers and engineers make sense of their observability data like the service map and trace waterfall. You'll play a vital role that users can successfully manage and troubleshoot their applications. You will be part of a skilled group of engineers and designers. You will contribute your expertise and learn from others. If you enjoy tackling complex challenges and want to make a meaningful impact on our product, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design and implement intuitive user interface components that enhance user experien, using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Integrate front-end elements seamlessly with back-end services to ensure a smooth user experience. Conduct usability testing and gather user feedback to drive continuous improvements.
  • Own complex, loosely-defined problems end-to-end: shape the approach, split the work if needed, make the key technical decisions, and deliver.
  • Lead discussions on architecture and system design. During these discussions, consider trade-offs. Also, think about backwards compatibility, performance, and scale.
  • Establish coding standards and ensure the team adheres to them throughout the development process. Promote reusable components to improve efficiency and implement automated testing and deployment to maintain code quality. Evaluate new technologies for potential integration and document best practices to facilitate team-wide knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. Offer constructive feedback and identify potential security vulnerabilities in the codebase. Focus on maintaining code readability and facilitate discussions with team members to address any findings from the code review.
  • Collaborate async across timezones with a fully-distributed team, working in the open on GitHub and in Slack.
  • Partner closely with designers and product managers to understand user experience goals and translate their mockups into functional UI components. Ensure a consistent visual design across all UI elements. Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate innovative ideas for enhancing the user interface.

What You Bring 

  • Solid production experience with full-stack JavaScript, preferably TypeScript; React on the front end and Node.js on the back end. Some experience with Reactflow is a plus.
  • A track record of leading non-trivial projects end-to-end, with real design ownership and minimal guidance.
  • Proficient architecture and system-design judgment, including in large, existing codebases.
  • Successfully designed and launched multiple user interface components that significantly increased user commitment.
  • You should have experience using AI-assisted development tools. These tools can help you develop features faster, fix complex systems, and improve existing codebases.
  • Exemplary written and verbal communication, and a genuine excitement for async collaboration and knowledge-sharing.
  • A multiplier mindset! You make the engineers around you better.
  • A generalist streak and a user-focused mindset, with consideration for the people using your software.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the Elastic stack, Open Telemetry, observability tooling, or log/data-ingestion pipelines.
  • Go, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development experience.
  • Experience building large user interfaces that manage a lot of data. This includes skills in search, filtering, and tables. You should also have experience working with streaming or real-time data.
  • Prior open-source / working-in-the-open experience
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

At Elastic, we have a simple goal: to pursue the world's data problems with products that delight and inspire. We help people around the world do extraordinary things with their data. From stock quotes to Twitter streams, Apache logs to WordPress blogs, our products are extending what's possible with data, delivering on the promise that good things come from connecting the dots. Often, what you can do with our products is only limited by what you can dream up. We believe that diversity drives our vibe. We unite employees across 30+ countries into one unified team, while the broader community spans across over 100 countries.

Elastic, makers of the hugely popular open source products Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, and Beats, is growing very fast and so is our marketing team. As a key member of the Marketing AI, Operations and Automation team, you will play a hands-on, critical role in governing and administering the marketing AI tool stack that teams across the organisation depend on. From configuring tools at the system level to reviewing AI-generated content before it goes live, you will be the operational backbone that keeps marketing AI running consistently, safely, and at scale.

Elastic is looking for a flexible and adaptable person with the ability to manage a variety of governance and administration responsibilities across a growing set of AI tools and platforms. This is an ideal position for a self-motivated individual who has experience administering enterprise marketing technology, is process oriented, and has the ability to work in a fast-paced, distributed environment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the AI-level configuration, system prompts, and governance standards for every tool in the approved marketing AI stack, ensuring consistency across the organisation rather than tool-by-tool drift.
  • Act as the human review layer for AI-generated content and submissions, serving as the final checkpoint before anything goes live when agents flag warnings.
  • Enforce the tool ownership model, ensuring every approved marketing AI tool has a named owner assigned before teams begin using it.
  • Maintain the internal prompt library, approved-use guidelines, and minimum starting prompts available to marketers across the organisation.
  • Partner with the Marketing AI Engineer to onboard new tools and workflows through the appropriate approval processes.
  • Surface tool-level usage patterns and review volume to inform resourcing and governance decisions as the team scales.
  • Assist in maintaining internal documentation across team knowledge bases, wikis, and the playbooks.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in a marketing operations or marketing technology role with tool administration responsibilities.
  • Hands-on experience working with at least one enterprise AI or generative AI platform at an organisational level, such as Jasper, Writer, or Adobe Firefly.
  • Demonstrated understanding of system-level prompt architecture and how AI configuration affects output quality and consistency across teams.
  • Strong process orientation with the ability to build governance workflows and documentation standards from scratch.
  • Familiarity with Marketo, Workfront, or similar enterprise marketing platforms.
  • Clear, precise written communication and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience working across globally distributed teams spanning AMER, EMEA, and APJ.

This role sits at the intersection of sales execution, technical fluency, and cross-functional collaboration—and is critical to our growth in the Mid Market segment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own your territory & build pipeline: Develop and execute a proactive outbound cadence (email, call, social) that generates ≥50 % of your booked opportunities.

  • Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.

  • Open Source enthusiasm: Genuine appreciation for open-source communities and the Elastic model—bonus if you’ve sold or advocated in an OSS context.

Bonus Points

  • Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.

  • Familiarity with observability (logs, metrics, traces) or security analytics (SIEM/XDR) use cases.

What Is The Role:

We are on the lookout for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your distributed systems expertise to build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have shown your ability to understand and work on complex, highly distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.
  • You demonstrate the ability to build and debug features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities.
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points:

  • Data stores
  • Search, analytics, Lucene
  • Strong knowledge of the JDK
  • Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty.

title: Principal Product Manager, Security Pricing and Packaging (Serverless) - Security Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role   We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own how Elastic Security is packaged, priced, and sold on Elastic Cloud Serverless. More customers want to run SIEM, endpoint, and cloud security on Serverless, and the commercial model decides whether that growth is profitable. You will own the security solution layer on top of the Serverless platform: the tiers, the meters, the margins, and what it is like for a customer to pay for security on a consumption model. The Platform team owns the underlying architecture. You will work with them so that what we sell can be delivered at a healthy margin and quoted with confidence. We are changing how we price and package, and you will help design the new model. You own the pricing recommendation, and executive executive team makes the final call. The role sits between Product, Finance, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing. Expect to explain to a CISO, a CFO, and a field seller why a SKU looks the way it does.   What You Will Be Doing
  • Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team.
  • Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships.
  • Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue.
  • Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy.
  • Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it.
  • Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities.
  • Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit.
  • You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one.
What You Bring
  • You have led pricing and packaging for a SaaS or cloud product end to end, from option design and customer testing through margin modeling and executive approval, and you can point to the revenue, margin, or adoption result. Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing is required, as is experience simplifying a model that had grown too complex.
  • Product experience with SIEM, XDR, endpoint, cloud security, or a security operations platform is a solid plus, and so is a background as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. If your pricing work was on another cloud or data product, the team will help you learn the security side.
  • You are comfortable with COGS, gross margin, and ARR modeling, and you can build a forecast with Finance without a translator.
  • You understand how multi-tenant cloud services are built and how architecture choices drive cost, well enough to read a technical design.
  • You lead through influence in a matrixed, remote-first company. You get enable teams to agree on a decision, work well asynchronously, and shift between priorities when the business changes.
  • You can present pricing to a CISO and a procurement team, and you have supported deals as the product expert.
  • You write PRDs, pricing proposals, and executive summaries that people act on. You use AI tools to improve pricing analysis and cost modeling, and you own the output.
  • You have 7 to 10 years in product management, including significant time on security or cloud data products. Experience at a security vendor, a cloud data platform, or a company that moved customers from licensed to consumption pricing is a plus.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Agents and Context - Platform
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.
  • Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.
  • Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.
  • Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.
  • Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.
  • Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.
  • Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.
  • A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.
  • Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.
  • Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.
  • Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.
  • Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.

  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention

What You Bring 

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have experience building authorization systems that are scalable and performant under high concurrency and large permission sets, including designing access models, validating credentials/tokens at scale, and keeping authorization decisions consistent across a distributed system.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still collaborating on the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, supporting decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. What is The Role

In this role, you will provide technical leadership for the Global UX engineering team, the group responsible for Elastic UI (EUI) - Elastic's design system and React component library - and the shared patterns, tokens, and tooling that give Elastic products a consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience.

EUI underpins the UI of every major Elastic product. As Tech Lead, you will set technical direction for how the design system scales across dozens of consuming teams, mentor and grow the engineers around you, and act as the senior-most technical voice connecting design intent to component architecture. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will write and review code, make the hard architectural calls, and also be the person other engineers and designers turn to when a component API, theming strategy, or migration path needs to be figured out.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer with deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and component library architecture, who has built or led design systems at scale, and who combines strong technical judgment with the leadership skills to align a team, a roadmap, and a community of internal consumers around a shared direction.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provide technical leadership for Elastic UI (EUI), setting direction for component architecture, API design, theming, accessibility, and long-term maintainability across a design system consumed by many product teams.
  • Own the hardest technical decisions in the system: composable component patterns, breaking-change and migration strategy, versioning, token architecture, and the tradeoffs between flexibility and consistency.
  • Act as tech lead for the Global UX engineering team - setting technical standards, reviewing designs, unblocking engineers on difficult problems, and ensuring the team's work ladders up to a coherent long-term architecture.
  • Partner closely with design leadership to translate design language, visual direction, and interaction patterns into robust, reusable, well-documented component APIs.
  • Drive adoption of the design system across Elastic by working directly with consuming teams, understanding their constraints, and evolving EUI's APIs and documentation so adoption is easy rather than forced.
  • Raise the bar on accessibility, performance, and cross-browser correctness for shared UI building blocks used throughout Elastic's products.
  • Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code review, design critique, and pairing, and help develop the next generation of senior and staff-level engineers.
  • Represent the Global UX team in cross-functional planning with product, design, and engineering leadership, and make the case for investment in design system health and developer experience.
  • Use profiling, telemetry, and feedback from consuming teams to identify where the design system is creating friction, and lead the initiatives that fix it.
  • Explore how AI can improve the design-to-code workflow - for example, component generation from design specs, automated accessibility checks, or AI-assisted migration tooling - while holding the team accountable for the quality and correctness of shipped components.

What You Bring 

  • Deep, hands-on expertise building and operating React and TypeScript component libraries or design systems in production, at a scale with many internal or external consumers.
  • A strong track record of technical leadership - setting architecture, raising quality standards across a team, and making decisions that other engineers align behind without needing formal authority.
  • Experience designing composable, flexible component APIs, including patterns like compound components, render props, headless components, and theming/token systems.
  • Strong instincts for accessibility (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard and screen-reader behavior) and a track record of building that rigor into a team's default practices.
  • Experience managing the lifecycle of a widely-consumed library: releases, breaking changes, deprecation and migration paths, and documentation that keeps adoption smooth.
  • Ability to partner directly with designers and design leadership, translating visual and interaction intent into technical constraints and component contracts.
  • Excellent judgment about when to invest in reusable abstractions versus one-off solutions, and the communication skills to explain those tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and elevating the technical level of a team, through code review, design docs, and pragmatic, hands-on leadership.
  • Experience working transparently in a distributed team - clear written communication, async-first collaboration, and open-source or open development practices.
  • Curiosity about how AI can improve design system workflows, paired with the judgment to hold a high bar for correctness and quality in whatever ships.

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people.
