What is The Role

In this role, you will provide technical leadership for the Global UX engineering team, the group responsible for Elastic UI (EUI) - Elastic's design system and React component library - and the shared patterns, tokens, and tooling that give Elastic products a consistent, accessible, and high-quality experience.

EUI underpins the UI of every major Elastic product. As Tech Lead, you will set technical direction for how the design system scales across dozens of consuming teams, mentor and grow the engineers around you, and act as the senior-most technical voice connecting design intent to component architecture. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will write and review code, make the hard architectural calls, and also be the person other engineers and designers turn to when a component API, theming strategy, or migration path needs to be figured out.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer with deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and component library architecture, who has built or led design systems at scale, and who combines strong technical judgment with the leadership skills to align a team, a roadmap, and a community of internal consumers around a shared direction.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Provide technical leadership for Elastic UI (EUI), setting direction for component architecture, API design, theming, accessibility, and long-term maintainability across a design system consumed by many product teams.
  • Own the hardest technical decisions in the system: composable component patterns, breaking-change and migration strategy, versioning, token architecture, and the tradeoffs between flexibility and consistency.
  • Act as tech lead for the Global UX engineering team - setting technical standards, reviewing designs, unblocking engineers on difficult problems, and ensuring the team's work ladders up to a coherent long-term architecture.
  • Partner closely with design leadership to translate design language, visual direction, and interaction patterns into robust, reusable, well-documented component APIs.
  • Drive adoption of the design system across Elastic by working directly with consuming teams, understanding their constraints, and evolving EUI's APIs and documentation so adoption is easy rather than forced.
  • Raise the bar on accessibility, performance, and cross-browser correctness for shared UI building blocks used throughout Elastic's products.
  • Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code review, design critique, and pairing, and help develop the next generation of senior and staff-level engineers.
  • Represent the Global UX team in cross-functional planning with product, design, and engineering leadership, and make the case for investment in design system health and developer experience.
  • Use profiling, telemetry, and feedback from consuming teams to identify where the design system is creating friction, and lead the initiatives that fix it.
  • Explore how AI can improve the design-to-code workflow - for example, component generation from design specs, automated accessibility checks, or AI-assisted migration tooling - while holding the team accountable for the quality and correctness of shipped components.

What You Bring 

  • Deep, hands-on expertise building and operating React and TypeScript component libraries or design systems in production, at a scale with many internal or external consumers.
  • A strong track record of technical leadership - setting architecture, raising quality standards across a team, and making decisions that other engineers align behind without needing formal authority.
  • Experience designing composable, flexible component APIs, including patterns like compound components, render props, headless components, and theming/token systems.
  • Strong instincts for accessibility (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard and screen-reader behavior) and a track record of building that rigor into a team's default practices.
  • Experience managing the lifecycle of a widely-consumed library: releases, breaking changes, deprecation and migration paths, and documentation that keeps adoption smooth.
  • Ability to partner directly with designers and design leadership, translating visual and interaction intent into technical constraints and component contracts.
  • Excellent judgment about when to invest in reusable abstractions versus one-off solutions, and the communication skills to explain those tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A history of mentoring engineers and elevating the technical level of a team, through code review, design docs, and pragmatic, hands-on leadership.
  • Experience working transparently in a distributed team - clear written communication, async-first collaboration, and open-source or open development practices.
  • Curiosity about how AI can improve design system workflows, paired with the judgment to hold a high bar for correctness and quality in whatever ships.

What is The Role

As a Channels & Alliances Manager on Channel Acceleration Team, you own the channel motion for the East Enterprise Region. You are the connective tissue between Elastic sellers, our partner ecosystem, and the customers they serve. You build partner-sourced pipeline, accelerate deal velocity, and turn partner strategy into repeatable plays the field actually uses.

What You Will Be Doing

Partner-Sourced Pipeline and Territory Strategy

  • Own partner-sourced pipeline generation and bookings for your assigned territory, in partnership with regional sales leadership.
  • Build and maintain a territory game plan. Map accounts on a recurring cadence and as new partners are onboarded, attaching an actionable channel play (security-first attach, free-to-paid conversion, or renewal expansion) with a clear next step and named owner.
  • Deliver concise, fluff-free regional channel strategy briefings to sales leadership and hold a routine seat on regional forecast calls.

Partner Activation and Enablement

  • Own inbound partner onboarding end to end: monitor the partner application queue, run onboarding calls, and execute the standard onboarding framework.
  • Drive joint business planning with focus and regional partners. Co-author the joint business plan with solutions architecture leadership, confirm portal access, map target accounts, and lock in a recurring partner cadence.
  • Equip partners with the enablement, assets, and plays they need to sell, build, and service with Elastic, and ensure Elastic sellers adopt them.

Deal Execution and Operational Rigor

  • Build, quality-check, and submit quotes across reseller, distributor, MSP, and hyperscaler motions, applying the correct programs and incentives.
  • Maintain pipeline hygiene: resolve territory duplicates, keep deal notes current, and ensure every opportunity carries an accurate status.
  • Enforce partner attach standards on security opportunities, ensuring an eligible focus security partner is attached before the deal advances.
  • Manage partner deal registrations end to end, including timely appeals on declined or disputed registrations.

Measurement and Reporting

  • Report on regional channel metrics including partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, partner attach rate, average deal size, and hyperscaler attach.
  • Monitor customer consumption and opportunity telemetry to surface risk and expansion early.
  • Tell the story behind the numbers: where the momentum is, where the gaps are, and what you are adjusting.

What You Bring

  • Experience in channel or partner management, alliances, or partner-facing sales, ideally within enterprise software, cloud, or data infrastructure.
  • A track record of generating partner-sourced pipeline and influencing revenue within an assigned territory.
  • Comfort operating in a CRM daily. Pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, and reporting are core to this role, not an afterthought.
  • Working knowledge of a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC, and the ability to coach partners through it.
  • Strong communication skills. You can brief a sales leader in five minutes without fluff, and write enablement a partner will actually use.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across sales, solutions architecture, marketing, operations, and legal to remove friction from partner transactions.
  • Self-directed and outcome-oriented. You ship, measure, and iterate.

Acting as a trusted technical advisor, you will work with enterprises to design, deliver, and scale security architectures that strengthen detection, response, and resilience.

You’ll collaborate with Elastic’s Professional Services, Engineering, Product, and Sales teams to accelerate adoption of the Elastic Security platform, ensuring customers maximize the value of their data while improving their security posture. This is a highly impactful role, with opportunities to guide strategy, lead complex implementations, and mentor both customers and teammates.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, outcome-driven solutions built on the Elastic Stack.

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of customer engagements — from discovery and design through implementation, enablement, and optimization.

  • Partner with customers to architect, deploy, and operationalize Elastic solutions that drive measurable value and adoption.

  • Capture and share best practices, lessons learned, and solution patterns across the Elastic Services community.

  • Familiarity with threat detection, incident response workflows, and security analytics best practices.

  • May require significant travel to customer sites to support engagements and solution implementations; candidates should be comfortable with varying levels of travel based on business needs.

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

We're looking for a Marketing Strategy & Planning Specialist to join the Global Growth and Experiences Marketing (GGEM) team. You'll report to the Head of Strategy & Planning (Chief of Staff), and work closely with the VP and senior leaders in the GGEM team.

Think of this role as the team's connective tissue. On the business side, you'll keep our global growth and experiential (field) marketing budget on track and our special projects moving. On the people side, you'll run programs that shape our team culture, like our all-hands, and build relationships across the whole department to find ways everyone can work better together.

This is an early-career role for someone who is sharp, persistent, and trusted with sensitive information, and who also genuinely enjoys people and communications. You'll learn how a global marketing organization plans, spends, and delivers, and you'll help make it a great place to work while you do.

This role is remote within Canada, with a preference for Mountain / Pacific time.

What You Will Be Doing

Budget & Financial Operations
  • Help oversee the global growth and experiential marketing budget: track spend against plan, reconcile actuals, and flag variances early.
  • Partner with Finance and regional marketing teams on forecasting, accruals, and quarterly budget reviews.
  • Help hold marketing teams accountable to finance best practices and standards. You'll monitor compliance, follow up persistently on gaps, and help teams understand and apply the process.
  • Use our finance and planning tools to track budgets, spend, and approvals.
  • Build clear budget summaries and trackers that make it easy for leaders to understand where we are and what needs a decision.
Team Culture & Connection
  • Own our team culture programs, including planning and running our all-hands from agenda to follow-up.
  • Create moments that bring a globally distributed team together, and keep them fresh by gathering feedback and trying new things.
  • Build solid relationships across the whole department. You'll be a familiar, friendly face to teams in every region and function.
  • Help people work better together by connecting the right folks, smoothing out friction, and making it easy to collaborate across teams.
Project & Program Coordination
  • Coordinate special projects on behalf of the group and the VP, from kickoff through completion: set timelines, assign owners, track dependencies, and follow up.
  • Keep projects organized with clear plans, status updates, and documented next steps.
  • Spot risks and gaps early, select what needs to be escalated and to whom, and raise it with a recommended path forward.
Communication & Executive Support
  • Write concise, well-tailored emails, updates, and presentations for audiences ranging from regional teams to senior leaders.
  • Prepare materials for business reviews, QBRs, and leadership meetings.
  • Handle confidential business and financial information with discretion.
  • Help maintain the team's operating rhythm: planning calendars, recurring reviews, and process documentation.
Process & Tools
  • Learn and use our finance, planning, and project management tools, and suggest ways to make our processes simpler and faster.

What You Bring

  • Experience in project coordination, program management, marketing operations, finance operations, event or internal communications, or a similar role. Internships and early-career experience count.
  • Strong attention to detail, with a habit of double-checking numbers, dates, and next steps.
  • Solid project management skills. You can juggle multiple workstreams, keep them organized, and follow through.
  • Persistence. You follow up politely and consistently until things get done, even when it takes several tries.
  • Good judgment. You know when to solve something yourself and when to escalate it, and you bring context and a recommendation when you do.
  • Discretion with confidential information, including budget, headcount, and strategic planning details.
  • Comfort with numbers and budgets. You're at ease in spreadsheets (Excel or Google Sheets) and ready to learn financial processes like forecasting and variance tracking.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can write crisp emails and build polished presentations, and you adjust your message to your audience.
  • Real warmth and people skills. You're energized by building relationships, you're a natural connector, and you can hold people accountable in a way that's respectful and clear.
  • Comfort learning new software tools quickly.
  • You're collaborative and proactive, and you're comfortable giving and receiving feedback.
  • You're located in Canada.

Bonus Points

  • Experience planning team events, all-hands, or internal programs.
  • Experience at a B2B or SaaS company.
  • Exposure to marketing, field marketing, or events.
  • Familiarity with tools like G-Suite, Zoom, Slack, Workday Strategic Sourcing, and Allocadia - as well as common project management tools.

title: Principal Product Manager, Security Pricing and Packaging (Serverless) - Security Solutions
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role   We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own how Elastic Security is packaged, priced, and sold on Elastic Cloud Serverless. More customers want to run SIEM, endpoint, and cloud security on Serverless, and the commercial model decides whether that growth is profitable. You will own the security solution layer on top of the Serverless platform: the tiers, the meters, the margins, and what it is like for a customer to pay for security on a consumption model. The Platform team owns the underlying architecture. You will work with them so that what we sell can be delivered at a healthy margin and quoted with confidence. We are changing how we price and package, and you will help design the new model. You own the pricing recommendation, and executive executive team makes the final call. The role sits between Product, Finance, Engineering, Sales, and Product Marketing. Expect to explain to a CISO, a CFO, and a field seller why a SKU looks the way it does.   What You Will Be Doing
  • Redesign how Security is packaged and priced on Serverless. Define the tiers, feature entitlements, and usage meters, select what is bundled, metered, or sold as an add-on, test the options against customer demand and COGS, and bring a recommendation to senior executive team.
  • Own margin. Work with the Platform team and Finance to model the cost of new security capabilities, including ingest, search, retention, endpoint, and AI features, and set pricing requirements before a feature ships.
  • Grow Security on Serverless from proof of concept to renewal. You are accountable for new workloads, migrations from hosted and self-managed deployments, expansion, and retention. Work with Finance to separate recurring growth from one-time proof-of-concept revenue.
  • Give customers control over cost and performance. Define how search configurations, data tiers, and retention work for security use cases, and bring the cost models that justify new platform levers. Keep tenant-level packaging consistent with the Product Manager for MSSP and multi-tenancy.
  • Simplify how customers understand cost. Cut packaging complexity first, then simplify the sizing and pricing estimators that customers and Solutions Architects use. Agree on a measure of "simple," such as time to a credible quote, and track it.
  • Turn pricing decisions into shipped product. Write the PRDs and PRFAQs, and lead the work across Security engineering, the Serverless Platform team, Billing and Metering, and Cloud Operations. Help build the frameworks and reviews that other Security PMs, Product Marketing, and Solutions Architects use to price new capabilities.
  • Stay close to the market and the field. Discuss with customers and prospects about what they will and won't pay for, track how other security platforms package and price, and help the field explain when Serverless, hosted, or self-managed is the right fit.
  • You know the main approaches to pricing AI features, such as token-based, credit-based, and per-action or outcome pricing, and how inference costs and unpredictable usage shape each one.
What You Bring
  • You have led pricing and packaging for a SaaS or cloud product end to end, from option design and customer testing through margin modeling and executive approval, and you can point to the revenue, margin, or adoption result. Experience with usage-based or consumption pricing is required, as is experience simplifying a model that had grown too complex.
  • Product experience with SIEM, XDR, endpoint, cloud security, or a security operations platform is a solid plus, and so is a background as a SOC analyst, detection engineer, or security architect. If your pricing work was on another cloud or data product, the team will help you learn the security side.
  • You are comfortable with COGS, gross margin, and ARR modeling, and you can build a forecast with Finance without a translator.
  • You understand how multi-tenant cloud services are built and how architecture choices drive cost, well enough to read a technical design.
  • You lead through influence in a matrixed, remote-first company. You get enable teams to agree on a decision, work well asynchronously, and shift between priorities when the business changes.
  • You can present pricing to a CISO and a procurement team, and you have supported deals as the product expert.
  • You write PRDs, pricing proposals, and executive summaries that people act on. You use AI tools to improve pricing analysis and cost modeling, and you own the output.
  • You have 7 to 10 years in product management, including significant time on security or cloud data products. Experience at a security vendor, a cloud data platform, or a company that moved customers from licensed to consumption pricing is a plus.

What Is The Role

Elastic, the Search Analytics company, is seeking a dynamic Public Sector Account Executive to support our growth into Federal and Higher Education accounts - a significant market opportunity for Elastic.This is a critical hire for our business, we need someone with a genuine track record selling into Federal and Higher Education clients, the instincts of a Challenger seller, and the hustle to build pipeline and create new opportunities in complex, multi stakeholder accounts. Always driving value for the customers we serve.

To excel as an Account Executive at Elastic, you need a blend of high-level technical curiosity and the gravitas of a value-based seller. Because Elastic isn't just a "product" but a versatile search, observability, and security platform, the role requires moving beyond simple transactions to solving complex data problems.

As a Public Sector Account Executive, you will be an integral part of our growth strategy. You will drive net-new revenue and expansion within Public Sector Accounts in an assigned territory. This is an opportunity for those passionate about empowering government and education  through innovative search technology and analytics, enabling them to unlock the full potential of their data.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Prospect & Create Opportunities: Proactively build and self generate pipeline in net new Federal and Higher Education accounts through outbound prospecting, partner, event and network driven activity and creative account penetration - this is a build role, not a farm role.
  • Drive Adoption: Fuel the adoption of Elastic’s AI-powered search solutions, Observability and Security solutions within (new) accounts while deepening engagement with existing ones.
  • Be a Trusted Advisor: Assist users and customers in harnessing the full power of search analytics to transform data into actionable insights.
  • Sovereignty & Compliance Fluency: Speak credibly to the data sovereignty, security clearance, and compliance requirements that shape how Federal clients evaluate and procure technology, and position Elastic's platform accordingly.
  • Solve Complex Problems: Help customers get ahead of exploding data volumes and emerging agentic AI-driven threats by giving them the observability and visibility to see, secure, and act on what's happening across their environment.
  • Champion Open Source: Articulate the value of our advanced commercial features while advocating for our Open-Source offerings.
  • Identify New Use Cases: Showcase how Elastic’s solutions enable users to work more efficiently and intelligently.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive business plans using community, customer, and partner ecosystems to drive significant territory growth.
  • Navigate Sales Cycles: Proactively identify new opportunities and successfully manage complex sales cycles.
  • Deep discovery & qualification: Uncover pain, business impact, budget, and decision criteria using frameworks like MEDDPICC so you chase only the highest-confidence deals.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Work hand-in-glove with Solutions Architects, Customer Success, Marketing, and RevOps to accelerate deals and drive exceptional customer outcomes.

What You Bring

  • The Right Blend: A combination of high-level technical curiosity and the grit of a value-based seller.
  • Proven Track Record: For this role we are specifically focusing on people who do have a proven selling track record with Federal and Higher Education accounts.
  • Challenger Mentality: You lead with insight, not features. You help customers learn something new about their business, tailor your message to different stakeholders and can respectfully have a point of view and can drive a conversation.
  • Value Storytelling: The ability to craft tailored narratives that link Elastic’s technical capabilities (Search, Observability, Security) to outcomes that matter for government and education - citizen, staff, student experience, tools and cost consolidation, and risk, compliance and public trust.
  • Executive negotiation & closing: Lead high-stakes contract and pricing discussions
  • Executive Communicator:  Confident presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior stakeholders, translating technical detail in a clear, credible business case.
  • Technical & cloud fluency: Comfortable discussing a broad range of technical topics including security, observability, vector/traditional search, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Relationship Building: Adept at establishing credibility with both technical developers and executive leadership.
  • Mutual deal strategy & forecast accuracy: Consistent, predictable and accurate sales forecasting skills. Collaborate with customers to build formal close plans and keep your CRM up to date.
  • Cross-Team Alignment: Ability to create alignment across teams to accelerate deals
  • AI Mentality: Use new technologies for performance advantage and deal structuring
  • Open-Source Appreciation: Enthusiasm for the Open-Source model and the community relying on our solutions.

Founded in 2012, Elastic is a distributed company with Elasticians supporting missions around the globe. Learn more at elastic.co.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to apply your technical expertise to high-impact public sector missions?

As a Federal Civilian Solutions Architect (SA) at Elastic, you will serve as the primary technical strategist and trusted advisor to Federal Civilian agencies, system integrators, and channel partners. You will map complex agency mission requirements—ranging from cyber defense and infrastructure monitoring to enterprise search and analytics—directly to the Elastic Stack.

In this role, you will lead technical engagements across the sales lifecycle, advocate for agency needs within Elastic product teams, and serve as a technical thought leader in the local D.C., Maryland, and Virginia (DMV) federal ecosystem.

We’re looking for architects and engineers with experience in influencing technical product, design and architecture decisions on technical merit, but also on value to the mission. Design experience with AI systems, foundation models, and closed LLM are highly desirable, especially when using data systems to provide secure enterprise context. Our solutions for Cyber security SIEM and XDR are highly relevant to mission objectives today that align to Federal cyber strategies, such as M2614 and Zero Trust. Experts in these topics should have the ability to thrive in this role and lead our customer engagements.

“We question the status quo, debate the best ways to accomplish our goals, and hold ourselves to the highest standards of performance. We take pride in understanding our public sector customers’ unique mission needs and delivering recommendations built on proven global deployments. Join this team if you are looking for a collaborative, high-growth environment where you can drive meaningful federal impact while elevating your career.”

— VP, Worldwide Solution Architecture

Location: Washington, D.C. / Baltimore, MD / Tysons Corner, VA Metropolitan Area (Hybrid – periodic in-office collaboration at the Elastic office in Reston/Tysons, VA required)

Travel: Up to 30% within the Federal Civilian territory, with occasional national/international events.

What You’ll Do 

  • Serve as Mission Strategist: Act as the lead technical advisor for your assigned Federal Civilian accounts, working alongside Account Executives to drive territory strategy from initial discovery to the technical win.

  • Architect Value-Driven Solutions: Develop a deep understanding of agency modernization mandates, IT goals, and operational pain points, articulating how Elastic delivers immediate mission value and cost optimization. Demonstrating knowledge, expertise and critical thinking to apply Elastic and integrate it with the overall enterprise data landscape.

  • Build Executive & Technical Trust: Cultivate lasting relationships across all levels of customer leadership, from program managers and enterprise architects to Agency CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs.

  • Drive Demonstrations & Proofs of Concept (POCs): Deliver compelling technical demonstrations, tailored POCs, and custom architectural prototypes to validate Elastic’s capabilities across search, observability, and security use cases.

  • Partner & Ecosystem Collaboration: Work closely with Federal System Integrators (FSIs), VARs, and strategic partners on joint account plans, RFIs/RFPs, and program captures.

  • Voice of the Federal Customer: Advocate for federal-specific requirements—such as compliance standards, air-gapped environment needs, and security controls—directly to Elastic product management and engineering.

  • Community Engagement: Represent Elastic at regional public sector events, federal user groups, and tech summits across the DMV area.

What You Bring

  • Location & Presence: Based in the Washington, D.C., Baltimore, MD, or Tysons Corner / Northern VA area, with the ability to work in a hybrid capacity and collaborate in-person at the Elastic Virginia office.

  • Presales Experience: 4+ years of experience as a Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer, or Technical Presales Consultant in the enterprise software or federal high-tech space.

  • Federal Domain Knowledge: Familiarity or direct experience supporting federal mission areas, with demonstrated experience in:

    • Healthcare & HHS
    • Fraud, Waste, and Abuse (FWA) & Regulatory Oversight
    • Federal Data & Analytics Initiatives
    • Financial Systems & Federal Reserve
    • International Affairs, State Department, and Civilian NGOs

  • Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success leading technical evaluations and analysis of alternatives (AOA), overcoming technical objections, and articulating the ROI of platform modernization and software re-architecture.

  • Technical & Strategic Influence: Proven ability to influence technical decision-makers and inspire confidence in both small technical teams and large executive audiences.

  • Continuous Curiosity: A passion for self-driven learning, keeping pace with emerging open-source technologies, cloud-native architecture, and AI/ML trends. Experience in Machine Learning (supervised and unsupervised), data resilience and failover architectures, systems designs are a plus.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 70/30 pay mix (base salary / target variable).  

The typical starting OTE range for new hires in this role is listed below.  This range represents the lowest to highest OTE we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.  

An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our APM UI team, where you'll have the chance to shape and enhance our user interface, making it more intuitive and engaging for our users. In this role, you'll work on Kibana and the UI components helping application developers and engineers make sense of their observability data like the service map and trace waterfall. You'll play a vital role that users can successfully manage and troubleshoot their applications. You will be part of a skilled group of engineers and designers. You will contribute your expertise and learn from others. If you enjoy tackling complex challenges and want to make a meaningful impact on our product, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Design and implement intuitive user interface components that enhance user experien, using TypeScript, React, and Node.js. Integrate front-end elements seamlessly with back-end services to ensure a smooth user experience. Conduct usability testing and gather user feedback to drive continuous improvements.
  • Own complex, loosely-defined problems end-to-end: shape the approach, split the work if needed, make the key technical decisions, and deliver.
  • Lead discussions on architecture and system design. During these discussions, consider trade-offs. Also, think about backwards compatibility, performance, and scale.
  • Establish coding standards and ensure the team adheres to them throughout the development process. Promote reusable components to improve efficiency and implement automated testing and deployment to maintain code quality. Evaluate new technologies for potential integration and document best practices to facilitate team-wide knowledge sharing.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews to ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. Offer constructive feedback and identify potential security vulnerabilities in the codebase. Focus on maintaining code readability and facilitate discussions with team members to address any findings from the code review.
  • Collaborate async across timezones with a fully-distributed team, working in the open on GitHub and in Slack.
  • Partner closely with designers and product managers to understand user experience goals and translate their mockups into functional UI components. Ensure a consistent visual design across all UI elements. Participate in brainstorming sessions to generate innovative ideas for enhancing the user interface.

What You Bring 

  • Solid production experience with full-stack JavaScript, preferably TypeScript; React on the front end and Node.js on the back end. Some experience with Reactflow is a plus.
  • A track record of leading non-trivial projects end-to-end, with real design ownership and minimal guidance.
  • Proficient architecture and system-design judgment, including in large, existing codebases.
  • Successfully designed and launched multiple user interface components that significantly increased user commitment.
  • You should have experience using AI-assisted development tools. These tools can help you develop features faster, fix complex systems, and improve existing codebases.
  • Exemplary written and verbal communication, and a genuine excitement for async collaboration and knowledge-sharing.
  • A multiplier mindset! You make the engineers around you better.
  • A generalist streak and a user-focused mindset, with consideration for the people using your software.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with the Elastic stack, Open Telemetry, observability tooling, or log/data-ingestion pipelines.
  • Go, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development experience.
  • Experience building large user interfaces that manage a lot of data. This includes skills in search, filtering, and tables. You should also have experience working with streaming or real-time data.
  • Prior open-source / working-in-the-open experience
  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading a small project team

descriptionHtml:

What is The Role

The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.

As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You will directly manage the engineers on the team, act as its primary project manager, and work with the PM and Tech Lead to define and deliver the roadmap. This is a people and delivery leadership role in a fast-moving space: the right person is energized by shaping structure where there is little, and keeps a calm, direct style while priorities shift.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own delivery of the Chat roadmap: break it into milestones, see around corners on risk, and make sure the team ships predictably.
  • Run hiring end to end for the team: job descriptions, interview loops, sourcing with Recruiting, and onboarding.
  • Coach and develop engineers at every level, with regular 1:1s, clear expectations and honest feedback.
  • Run performance management with consistency: promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution.
  • Partner with the Tech Lead and PM to shape roadmap and priorities, and with data science, UX, and the other Agents and Context teams on shared primitives and quality signals.
  • Build and improve team process (planning, async communication, release and on-call practice) through consensus and clear writing rather than top-down mandate.
  • Represent the team to leadership and stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • A proven track record as an established engineering manager of software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, promotions and performance management.
  • A track record of delivering large, multi-team software initiatives in a distributed, async-first environment, including creating or improving team processes.
  • Previous hands-on software engineering experience as a senior contributor, with enough technical depth to understand a TypeScript/Node/React stack, an Elasticsearch-backed system, and how LLM-powered products are built and evaluated. You will not write production code, but you need to spot bottlenecks, risks and one-way-door decisions.
  • Familiarity with LLM applications, ideally including RAG, agents and tool use, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, search and information retrieval, or open source communities is a plus.
  • Product acumen: comfortable with ambiguity, able to set and communicate priorities, and genuinely interested in what makes an agentic product good for users.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, concise long-form writing is how this team works.
  • Direct, kind, calm and empathetic. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.

title: RVP - UK Defence and Inteligence
descriptionHtml:

Elastic, the Search AI company, is looking for a NEW high-energy Regional Vice President to manage the Sales function across the UK Defence, Intelligence, and National Security sectors. This position offers a unique opportunity to manage and shape Elastic’s strategy for this critical public sector vertical, including new logo acquisition across the Ministry of Defence (MoD), prime contractors, and the wider Intelligence Community.
You will be responsible for 1st Line Leadership across the sector—establishing a scalable, repeatable public sector sales motion and unlocking growth in one of Elastic’s most mission-critical segments. This role will report into the Global Vice President for Public Sector sales.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Manage and grow a team of Accomplished Account Executives dedicated to the UK Defence and National Security markets.
  • Build and execute a winning sales strategy tailored to the unique procurement frameworks, security protocols, and mission objectives of the UK defence landscape.
  • Foster a culture of energy, growth mindset, and high performance—motivating your team to achieve extraordinary results.
  • Lead from the front: actively engage in strategic, high-value government deals, coach your team, and set the standard for excellence.
  • Design and implement scalable sales processes, compliant capture management plans, and strategic account segmentation across defence commands and intelligence agencies.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and specialized Public Sector Partner/SI teams to deliver mission-ready value and innovation to customers.
  • Ensure quota attainment and drive Elastic’s enterprise sales methodology within complex, long-cycle public sector procurement routes (e.g., Crown Commercial Service frameworks).
  • Champion teamwork, transparency, creativity, and continuous improvement.
  • Travel regularly across the UK to assist in deal creation, secure facility meetings, and closure, as well as providing strong leadership and support to your field team.
  • Partner across Elastic’s leadership community to ensure a seamless, highly secure customer experience from onboarding to deployment.

What You Bring
  • Proven sales leader with extensive experience running high-performing enterprise SaaS or software sales teams within the UK Defence, MoD, or National Security verticals.
  • Deep understanding of UK public sector procurement pathways and defense framework agreements.
  • Experienced to lead in a complex, matrixed global technology organization.
  • Growth mindset: resilient, curious, and motivated to build and scale a mission-critical sector.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills.
  • Experience designing and implementing structured sales strategies, capture plans, and territory management models for government accounts.
  • Existing relationships with key UK defence primes, systems integrators, and crown stakeholders.
  • Holding an active UK Security Clearance (SC or DV clearance), or eligibility and willingness to undergo the vetting process.
Bonus Points
  • Prior experience at an open-source or developer‐centric infrastructure company.
  • Familiarity with how observability (logs, metrics, traces) and security analytics (SIEM/XDR) protect critical national infrastructure (CNI) and support cyber defence operations.

title: Senior Security Research Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team researches, designs, and builds the visibility and prevention capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We are looking for a Senior Security Research Engineer to help lead our efforts to build innovative features that secure our users against the latest emerging threats. You will collaborate with the broader Elastic Security team, a diverse group of skilled researchers, data scientists, and engineers who bring deep domain knowledge in their respective areas. Our geographically dispersed team values positivity and inclusivity in the workplace, clear communication, collaborative learning, and guided mentorship.

We don't just claim our protections work. In recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you have a passion for security research and would enjoy the challenge of devising novel methods for thwarting malicious actors in an ever-evolving threat landscape, join our growing team!

What You Will Be Doing

  • Research emerging attacker techniques and turn them into shipped protections. Study real-world tradecraft across in-memory threats, injection, credential theft, ransomware, and kernel tampering, then design protections that hold up against an adversary actively trying to defeat them.
  • Build and extend endpoint visibility. Instrument new event sources across Windows, macOS, and Linux, deepen the telemetry we already collect, and close the gaps attackers rely on. Every source you add becomes a foundation for other teams.
  • Develop production code that runs everywhere. Write performant, stable C/C++ that executes on millions of endpoints, where a memory leak or a few milliseconds of overhead is a customer-visible problem.
  • Reverse engineer malware and study evasion. Learn how attackers bypass endpoint security controls in the wild, and feed that understanding directly into the protections you design and harden.
  • Own efficacy end to end. Review customer telemetry at fleet scale, investigate false positives and performance regressions, and establish mitigation strategies. Shipping the feature is the beginning of the job, not the end.
  • Extend protection parity across platforms. Bring the depth we have on Windows to macOS and Linux, and support new hardware architectures as they reach the enterprise.
  • Collaborate across Elastic Security. Implement endpoint code alongside peers in multiple countries and time zones, and work with the detection engineers, malware researchers, and data scientists who rely on your telemetry.
  • Help lead the team's technical direction. Take point on initiatives that span multiple releases, raise the bar in design and code reviews, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers.
  • Publish and present. Share your research on Elastic Security Labs, present at conferences, and contribute to the open source projects that organizations around the world rely on.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of professional experience analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and building detection methods for real security threats.
  • 6+ years of development experience in C, C++, and Python, with the judgment to write code that is safe, fast, and maintainable in a security-critical codebase.
  • Deep operating system internals knowledge, in both kernel and user mode, deep enough to reason about undocumented behavior and find security-relevant structures nobody has written about yet. Windows depth is what we need most, with macOS or Linux depth close behind.
  • In-depth reverse engineering and malware analysis experience, and comfort with the tooling that makes hard binaries readable.
  • An adversarial instinct. You anticipate how a protection will be evaded before it ships, and design for resilience rather than for the proof of concept in front of you.
  • A collaborative mentality and an eagerness to learn new skills, new platforms, and emerging technologies.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
  • Passion for protecting the world's data from attack!

Bonus Points

  • Vulnerability research and exploit development, particularly with a track record of responsible disclosure to platform vendors.
  • Red teaming experience, or a background in building offensive tooling and defeating endpoint security products.
  • Kernel-mode development, including driver development and debugging.
  • Ownership or long-term maintenance of an open-source security tool with a real user base.
  • Conference speaking experience (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, CODE BLUE, Virus Bulletin) or an established publication record.
  • Experience applying machine learning to endpoint security problems.
  • Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) and Elastic Security.

An account SA wins one deal at a time. You build technical capability across a focused group of partners (SIs, resellers, MSSPs, cloud providers) so they can source pipeline, win deals, and deliver Elastic on their own.   The role has three pillars: drive partner-sourced pipeline; multiply technical capacity and co-build repeatable solutions.   You will work a defined portfolio of managed partners, each with an agreed technical engagement plan, and be measured on outputs, partner sourced deals, committed engagement plans and published assets, not on activity volume but impact.   We are currently considering candidates who are located in or within close proximity to the Florida Panhandle (including Pensacola, Fort Walton Beach, and neighboring communities). Candidates outside of this geographic area will not be considered for this role.   Prior presales experience in the software sector is required for this role in the US Public Sector. It is a sales-aligned position that carries a partner-sourced pipeline target and candidates should plan for up to 30% travel.  

What you will be doing

  Drive growth with and through partners
  • Generate approved partner deal registrations, jointly owned with Partner Managers for your territory.
  • Run partner-tailored sales playbooks on registered deals: qualify the deal shape, support intake and technical scoping, and help partners attach their own services, lifting average deal size.
  • Accelerate partner-led opportunities, hands-on labs and proofs of concept, in collaboration with account AEs and SAs.
  • Stays current on competitive dynamics and market trends, equipping partners with sharp "Why Elastic" positioning over competing vendors
Architect of leverage
  • Own the technical relationships and named champions at each partner in your portfolio; build trusted advisor status with senior technical stakeholders.
  • Create, commit and maintain a Technical Engagement Plan per focus partner, the technical section of the Joint Business Plan, and run quarterly read-outs with the partner, Partner Manager and other stakeholders.
  • Deliver enablement and certification roadmaps, accreditations & certifications, that move partners up a defined technical maturity model.
  • Leads hands-on technical lab workshops across Elastic products, building partner technical confidence and solution fluency
Co-innovate on repeatable solutions
  • Co-architect solution blueprints and reference architectures with partners, including hyperscalers.
  • Build reusable demos, sales cards and battlecards partners can run without Elastic in the room; co-publish reference win stories and joint blog posts.
  • Authors customer-facing content including white papers, blogs, and sales collateral, informed by market trends and deep relationships with partner technical leaders
  • Supports technical deployments of Elastic in partner labs, demonstration environments, and testing grounds

What you bring

  • 2+ years e in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting and/or cloud/infrastructure technologies.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 1+ years of pre-sales experience in the software sector, ideally partner-facing: channel, alliances, SI/GSI or MSSP ecosystems in the US Public Sector.
  • A one-to-many mindset: you would rather teach ten engineers to run the demo than run it ten times yourself, and you can show where your enablement turned into someone else's win.
  • Working knowledge of security operations (SIEM, endpoint, cloud security) and/or observability, plus an understanding of AI and semantic search technologies.
  • Professional experience architecting or operating solutions on AWS, Google Cloud or Microsoft Azure.
  • Commercial fluency: you can read a deal, discuss services scope and margin with a partner, and translate technical capability into the business case their customer buys.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a self-starter's bias to action; you inspire partner teams to work on what is most relevant, not just what is urgent.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay focused and deliver results amid ambiguity, distractions, and competing priorities.
  • Comfortable operating both collaboratively across partner and cross-functional teams and independently to execute a plan and deliver results
  • Skilled at leading through influence, aligning partners and internal stakeholders around shared priorities and goals
  • Technical experience in at least one Elastic solution area is highly desired (AI agents & Search, security operations, or observability); cross-domain fluency across all three is a differentiator
  • Must be able to travel to partner offices, events, and conferences in support of partner activities; approximately 30% travel expected
  • Must be located in or within reasonable commuting distance of the Florida Panhandle (e.g., Pensacolarea or be willing to immediately relocate
Bonus Points
  • Meaningful, demonstratable, experience with AI/ML technologies, including exposure to LLMs, embeddings, vector search, or agentic AI frameworks
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Bash, or similar) for automation, integration, or demonstration purposes
  • Prior experience in a technical training, instruction, or curriculum development capacity is a plus

title: Senior Java Engineer - Core/Infra - Elasticsearch
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is the Role

We are on the lookout for a Senior Java Engineer to join our Elasticsearch team and focus on ensuring that the shared platform functionalities of Elasticsearch are easy to use, performant, maintainable and secure.

The team’s mission is to create foundational infrastructure and shared functionality that enables engineers to develop, extend, and support Elasticsearch. The team owns common functionality such as services, settings and scripting, and makes Elasticsearch extensible through plugins or the Painless scripting language. The team also makes Elasticsearch observable by providing logging and telemetry information. We also own the orchestration of Elasticsearch in serverless, the CI/CD workflows and enable Elasticsearch developers to deliver Elasticsearch to customers - serverless, cloud and on-premise alike.

You will be a strong individual contributor on the team but you will also contribute to and lead cross team projects. We need someone who has great design skills, who can work at a low level of abstraction but can equally drive and communicate technical concepts across a variety of collaborators.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to large, impactful projects that evolve the core infrastructure that underpins Elasticsearch.
  • Making Elasticsearch developers more productive by identifying and developing opportunities for automation, and integrating agentic apps into development workflows.
  • Designing and implementing new horizontally-scalable features and APIs in Elasticsearch.
  • Solving difficult issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Improving operation and observability of Elasticsearch cloud systems.
  • Collaborating in the open with the ES team, Elastic users, and other supporting open source projects.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring 

  • Experience crafting APIs and the ability to reason through tradeoffs.
  • Proficiency in algorithms and data structures.
  • Strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.
  • Experience with low-level Java such as concurrency, parallelism, classloaders, etc.
  • Knowledge of JDK internals: modules, the Java memory model, garbage collection, database load, caching techniques, etc.
  • Experience leading large scale projects across engineering teams.
  • Willingness to dive into new issues and ask for help when you need it.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working in a platform team or developer productivity team
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems and practices (Buildkite, Argo CD, GitOps etc).
  • Knowledge of Java build tools (Gradle, Maven, etc), with a strong preference for Gradle experience.
  • Experience with observability and telemetry solutions, particularly OpenTelemetry
  • Knowledge of Go
  • Knowledge of containers and Kubernetes

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary.  This role does not have a variable compensation component.

Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

We are on the lookout for a Principal Software Engineerto join our Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes. 

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.
  • Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.
  • Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.
  • Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.
  • Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.
  • Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.
  • Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.

What You Bring:

  • You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.
  • You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services. 
  • You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.
  • You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.

These features include authentication, authorization, and tenant isolation. You will work with engineering and product leaders at Elastic. Your goal is to participate in providing high-performance security at all levels. This includes ensuring that our distributed data store has top-quality security at scale.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Contributing to core security initiatives from architecture to production, focusing on the delivery of new critical features. Participating in the technical design, planning, and execution for major security components inside the Elasticsearch core engine.
  • Developing the foundational security models for features.
  • Optimizing security performance at scale in distributed systems environments.
  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention

What You Bring 

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have experience building authorization systems that are scalable and performant under high concurrency and large permission sets, including designing access models, validating credentials/tokens at scale, and keeping authorization decisions consistent across a distributed system.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still collaborating on the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, supporting decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

  • Applying cryptographic solutions to address genuine customer use cases.
  • Ensuring robust data isolation within shared infrastructure supporting disparate customers.
  • Monitoring and applying the latest advancements and best practices in security. This includes authentication, identity management, cryptography, and data access management.
  • Collaborating with peers across the company to embed security into new customer features from the outset.
  • Drive vulnerability management efforts by collaborating closely with the InfoSec team to proactively identify, assess, and remediate security risks.
  • Leverage AI-driven tools to automate vulnerability triage, prioritization, and preliminary investigation, streamlining security workflows and reducing manual intervention

What You Bring 

  • You have deep knowledge of Java internals and JVM memory management. You understand how concurrency models work. You can write code that is high-performance, thread-safe, and lock-free. This experience includes working with large open-source and enterprise codebases.
  • You have experience building authorization systems that are scalable and performant under high concurrency and large permission sets, including designing access models, validating credentials/tokens at scale, and keeping authorization decisions consistent across a distributed system.
  • You have a solid comprehension of distributed systems security, including node-to-node mutual trust, zero-trust transport, partition tolerance and cluster state propagation.
  • You have a deep knowledge of edge identity protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML).
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still collaborating on the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You can work autonomously, supporting decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication

Bonus Points

  • Knowledge of cipher suites, TLS handshakes, and PKI/certificate lifecycle management.
  • Cryptographic methods considering memory usage and delays.
  • Familiarity with the implications of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) and readiness to support the migration of services to quantum-resistant cryptographic algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience mapping engine-level technical controls to FedRAMP (Moderate/High), FIPS 140, and SOC 2 requirements.
  • Experience working on the internals of a data store or search engine.

title: Senior Services Sales Executive, Enterprise Accounts
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role

At Elastic, we believe that search is more than just a box—it's a way to solve the world's most complex data challenges. As a Senior Services Sales Executive for our Enterprise Accounts segment, you will be the primary driver of professional services growth across our highest-value relationships across our Enterprise business in the U.S. This is a quota-carrying sales role: you own the full services sales cycle—from pipeline origination through commercial close—across a portfolio of Global 500 and industry-leading accounts.

You are not just a trusted advisor; you are a closer. You arrive with an established network of senior relationships in the enterprise segment—and you know how to activate them. You translate executive credibility and long-standing trust into pipeline, navigate complex organizational dynamics, and convert ambitious customer goals into scoped, commercially sound multi-million dollar engagement programs. You partner closely with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to embed services as a strategic pillar of every account plan, and you work hand-in-hand with our delivery leaders to ensure what you sell lands with exceptional outcomes.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own Your Number: Carry and consistently achieve a services bookings quota across a named portfolio of Enterprise accounts. Build and maintain a healthy, stage-accurate pipeline with strong forecast discipline in Salesforce.
  • Drive New Business: Proactively identify and originate services opportunities within existing accounts and new-to-services logos. You don't wait for the phone to ring—you map whitespace, uncover initiatives, and create demand.
  • Lead the Full Services Sales Cycle: Run discovery, lead solutioning sessions, develop Statements of Work, structure creative commercial arrangements (T&M, fixed-fee, milestone-based), negotiate terms, and close. You own this process end-to-end.
  • Sell Complex, Multi-Year Engagements: Architect and sell multi-phase, multi-million dollar programs tied to customers' largest transformation bets—modernization initiatives, platform migrations, security programs, and AI/analytics buildouts.
  • Activate and Expand Your Network: You bring an established book of executive relationships in the enterprise segment—and you put them to work. From day one, you leverage existing trust with CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, and SVPs of Engineering to open doors, accelerate pipeline, and land early wins. Over time, you deepen those relationships and expand your reach into new stakeholders within the accounts you own.
  • Partner with the Field: Work side-by-side with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to co-develop account plans, align on services investment strategies, and present a unified value story to customers. You amplify—not duplicate—the field team. We are not order takers, but rather help shape the larger Elastic strategy with our customers.
  • Develop Compelling Business Cases: Lead ROI conversations and construct value frameworks that link Elastic's services investments to measurable customer outcomes—reduced time-to-value, improved MTTD/MTTR, lower operational costs, faster platform adoption.
  • Shape Engagements for Delivery Success: Collaborate with Services Delivery leadership to scope engagements that are both winnable and deliverable. You set your customers and delivery teams up to succeed from day one.
  • Contribute to Practice Growth: Share field intelligence on buyer patterns, competitive dynamics, and packaging gaps to help Elastic continuously sharpen its services offerings for the Enterprise market.

What You Bring

  • A Proven Services Sales Track Record: 10+ years of quota-carrying professional services sales experience, with consistent attainment selling into enterprise or strategic/global accounts. You have personally originated and closed multi-million dollar services engagements.
  • An Established Network You Can Activate: You bring pre-existing executive relationships in the Fortune 500 / enterprise segment—and a track record of converting those relationships into revenue. You don't need to spend your first year earning introductions; you arrive ready to open conversations and move deals.
  • Strategic Account Depth: Demonstrated experience managing a portfolio of complex, high-stakes accounts—not just renewing, but growing. You know what it takes to be trusted at the executive level over the long term, and you've done it.
  • Commercial Sophistication: You are fluent in services deal structures—T&M, fixed-fee, managed services, subscription-based delivery models. You've negotiated Master Services Agreements, SOWs, and custom commercial terms with procurement and legal teams.
  • Solutioning Credibility: You can lead technical scoping conversations. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you can translate customer architecture goals into realistic, well-scoped engagement plans that earn buy-in from both the buyer and the delivery team.
  • Executive Presence: You are comfortable and effective in C-suite conversations. You ask sharp discovery questions, listen actively, and earn a seat at the table—not just a slot on the agenda.
  • Pipeline Discipline: You build pipeline with intention and manage it rigorously. You forecast accurately, move deals with urgency, and never let momentum die on the customer's side.
  • Field Collaboration: You thrive in a co-selling model. You know how to align with AEs, SEs, CSMs, and delivery leaders to drive the right outcome for the account—without ego or turf.
  • Curiosity for the Technology: You don't need to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about how the technology works—and you invest in understanding it. You'll take the time to learn Elastic's platform, speak credibly about search, observability, and security use cases, and hold your own in conversations with technical buyers to earn you a seat at the table.
  • Domain Relevance: Experience selling services in the search, observability, security, data analytics, or broader enterprise software space strongly preferred. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and modern data architectures is a plus.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in a technical or business field. MBA or similar advanced degree is a plus.

Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary plus a variable component, that together comprise the On-Target Earnings (OTE).  On-Target Earnings (OTE) are based on a 80/20 pay mix (base salary / target variable).  

The typical starting OTE range for new hires in this role is listed below.  This range represents the lowest to highest OTE we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future.  

An employee's position within the OTE range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.
